title_quote: Good evening, is this number twenty three?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🏡 實用寄宿家庭必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡800句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 800 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Staying with a Host Family
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「寄宿家庭」情境對話：從第一晚在門口確認門牌號、脫鞋與拿鑰匙、問無線網路名字和密碼、九點以後能不能洗澡、早餐吃燕麥還是吐司、看玄關一整排家人的照片、晚回家前先傳一則訊息，到離開前送一小盒茶。每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫，800 句循環聽（400 對），A2 程度，語氣平穩，不用背、不用看畫面，睡覺聽就會。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical 'Staying with a Host Family' phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). The first week of a student living with a host family: checking the house number at the door, shoes off and the key ring, the wifi name and the password card, when the upstairs bath is free, breakfast at the kitchen table, the photographs along the hall, texting before a late bus home, and a small box of tea at the end. 800 lines (400 pairs), CEFR A2, calm and easy to follow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good evening, is this number twenty three?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈivnɪŋ ɪz ðɪs ˈnʌmbɚ ˈtwɛnti θri/
dialogue.zh: 晚上好，請問這裡是二十三號嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, you must be the new student.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ju mʌst bi ðə nu ˈstjudənt/
dialogue.zh: 是的，你一定是那位新來的學生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hope I am not too late.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hoʊp aɪ æm nɑt tu leɪt/
dialogue.zh: 希望我沒有太遲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are early, actually, by ten minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr ˈɜrli ˈæktʃuəli baɪ tɛn ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 其實你還早到了十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, the driver left my bag behind.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ðə ˈdraɪvɚ lɛft maɪ bæɡ bɪˈhaɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 等一下，司機把我的袋子落在車上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, was it the big brown one?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ wʌz ɪt ðə bɪɡ braʊn wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 哎呀，是那個棕色的大袋子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, with the blue tag on the handle.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wɪð ðə blu tæɡ ɑn ðə ˈhændəl/
dialogue.zh: 對，把手上綁著名牌的那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will call him, he lives two streets away.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl kɔl hɪm hi lɪvz tu strits əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我打給他，他住兩條街外。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you, it only has clothes inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ɪt ˈoʊnli hæz kloʊz ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，裡面只有幾件衣服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It can wait until morning, do not worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kæn weɪt ʌnˈtɪl ˈmɔrnɪŋ du nɑt ˈwɜri/
dialogue.zh: 可以留到早上，先別擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is my passport, as you asked.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz maɪ ˈpæspɔrt æz ju æskt/
dialogue.zh: 這是我的護照，你之前要的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, I will keep it on the shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks aɪ wɪl kip ɪt ɑn ðə ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，我會把它擱在架子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to sign anything tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tu saɪn ˈɛniˌθɪŋ təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 今天晚上我需要簽什麼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the house rules sheet, tomorrow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ðə haʊs rulz ʃit təˈmɑroʊ/
dialogue.zh: 只有住家規則那張，明天再簽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your porch light was on from the road.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr pɔrtʃ laɪt wʌz ɑn frʌm ðə roʊd/
dialogue.zh: 從馬路就看見你們的門廊燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I left it on so you could find us.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ lɛft ɪt ɑn soʊ ju kʊd faɪnd ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 我故意留著，好讓你找得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, that gate was easy to spot.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðæt ɡeɪt wʌz ˈizi tu spɑt/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，那道柵門很好認。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We worried the address was hard.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈwɜrid ðə əˈdrɛs wʌz hɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 我們還擔心這個地址難找。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I walked past the bakery and the park.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɔkt pæst ðə ˈbeɪkəri ænd ðə pɑrk/
dialogue.zh: 我沿路經過麵包店和那個公園。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The park path saves five minutes, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pɑrk pæθ seɪvz faɪv ˈmɪnɪts raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 走公園那條小路省五分鐘，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is raining a little on my coat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈreɪnɪŋ ə ˈlɪtəl ɑn maɪ koʊt/
dialogue.zh: 我的外套上淋了一點雨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hang it on the hook beside the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæŋ ɪt ɑn ðə hʊk bɪˈsaɪd ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 掛在門邊的鉤子上就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I wait here in the hallway?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ weɪt hɪr ɪn ðə ˈhɔlˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我要先在玄關等一會兒嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Come inside, the kitchen is warmer.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌm ɪnˈsaɪd ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn ɪz ˈwɔrmɚ/
dialogue.zh: 進來吧，廚房裡比較暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your hallway smells like cedar wood.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr ˈhɔlˌweɪ smɛlz laɪk ˈsidɚ wʊd/
dialogue.zh: 你們的玄關有雪松木的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My mother polished that bench for years.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈmʌðɚ ˈpɑləʃt ðæt bɛntʃ fɔr jɪrz/
dialogue.zh: 那張長凳是我媽媽擦過好多年的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This cat is not afraid of me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs kæt ɪz nɑt əˈfreɪd əv mi/
dialogue.zh: 這隻貓好像不怕我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He greets every guest at the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi ɡreets ˈɛvri ɡɛst æt ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 牠會在門口跟每位客人問好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So calm, what is his name?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ kɑm wɑt ɪz hɪz neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 好安靜啊，牠叫什麼名字？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Biscuit, and he wants your lap.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɪskɪt ænd hi wɑnts jɔr læp/
dialogue.zh: 叫 Biscuit，他想跳上你的腿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eleven hours in the air, at last.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪˈlɛvən ˈaʊərz ɪn ði ˈɛr ɑt læst/
dialogue.zh: 在天上飛了十一小時，總算到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You look tired, would tea help first?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju lʊk ˈtaɪərd wʊd ti hɛlp fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 你看起來累了，先喝杯茶好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tea sounds perfect right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ti saʊndz ˈpɜrfɪkt raɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 現在喝茶剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Milk or lemon with yours?
dialogue.phonetic: /mɪlk ɔr ˈlɛmən wɪð jɔrz/
dialogue.zh: 你那杯要加奶還是檸檬？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just milk, and one biscuit maybe.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst mɪlk ænd wʌn ˈbɪskɪt ˈmeɪbi/
dialogue.zh: 只要牛奶，也許再加一塊餅乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The kitchen lamp is warm, follow me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn læm ɪz wɔrm ˈfɑloʊ mi/
dialogue.zh: 廚房燈下很暖，跟著我走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your kitchen table is very old.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr ˈkɪtʃɪn ˈteɪbəl ɪz ˈvɛri oʊld/
dialogue.zh: 你家的餐桌好有年份。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It came with the house in nineteen sixty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt keɪm wɪð ðə haʊs ɪn naɪnˈtin ˈsɪksti/
dialogue.zh: 一九六○年它就跟著這棟房子了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that my schedule on the fridge?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt maɪ ˈskɛdʒul ɑn ðə frɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 冰箱上貼的是我的課表嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, school starts Monday at eight fifteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs skul stɑrts ˈmʌndeɪ æt eɪt fɪfˈtin/
dialogue.zh: 對，週一八點十五分上課。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I be at the gate earlier?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ bi ət ðə ɡeɪt ˈɜrliər/
dialogue.zh: 我是不是應該早一點到門口？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten minutes early is plenty for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈmɪnɪts ˈɜrli ɪz ˈplɛnti fɔr ju/
dialogue.zh: 早十分鐘就很夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I do not like running late much.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ du nɑt laɪk ˈrʌnɪŋ leɪt mʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 我不太喜歡趕時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nobody in this house likes that either.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊˌbɑdi ɪn ðɪs haʊs laɪks ðæt ˈiðɚ/
dialogue.zh: 這間屋裡也沒有人喜歡那樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone is almost dead, sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ foʊn ɪz ˈɔlmoʊst dɛd ˈsɑri/
dialogue.zh: 我手機快沒電了，抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the outlet under the kitchen counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ði ˈaʊtlɛt ˈʌndɚ ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn ˈkaʊntɚ/
dialogue.zh: 先用流理台下面的那個插座。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the plug adaptor I need?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz ðə plʌɡ əˈdæptɚ aɪ nid/
dialogue.zh: 我需要的轉接插頭在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Second drawer, down from the top.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛkənd drɔr daʊn frʌm ðə tɑp/
dialogue.zh: 從上面數下來的第二個抽屜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that your husband in the chair?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt jɔr ˈhʌzbənd ɪn ðə tʃɛr/
dialogue.zh: 椅子上那位是妳先生嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is Ray, he reads before bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz reɪ hi ridz bɪˈfɔr bɛd/
dialogue.zh: 那是 Ray，他睡覺前會看書。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I shake his hand, or wave?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ ʃeɪk hɪz hænd ɔr weɪv/
dialogue.zh: 我該跟他握手，還是揮揮手？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ray likes a wave and a quiet hello.
dialogue.phonetic: /reɪ laɪks ə weɪv ænd ə ˈkwaɪət hɛˈloʊ/
dialogue.zh: Ray 喜歡輕輕揮手，小聲問好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A quiet hello suits me, too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈkwaɪət hɛˈloʊ suts mi tu/
dialogue.zh: 安靜打招呼也很合我的個性。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He is shy with new people, be patient.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi ɪz ʃaɪ wɪð nu ˈpipəl bi ˈpeɪʃənt/
dialogue.zh: 他見到生人會害羞，慢慢來就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No hurry at all tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈhɜri ət ɔl təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 今晚一點也不趕時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your tea is ready, sit by the window.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr ti ɪz ˈrɛdi sɪt baɪ ðə ˈwɪnˌdoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 你的茶好了，坐窗邊那張椅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, this window faces your garden.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ðɪs ˈwɪnˌdoʊ ˈfeɪsɪz jɔr ˈɡɑrdən/
dialogue.zh: 你看，這扇窗正對著你們的花園。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomatoes in summer, snowdrops in spring.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈmeɪtoʊz ɪn ˈsʌmɚ ˈsnoʊˌdrɑps ɪn sprɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 夏天種番茄，春天有雪滴花。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe I should stay until spring.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi aɪ ʃʊd steɪ ʌnˈtɪl sprɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 也許我該一路待到春天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we will count the flowers together.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi wɪl kaʊnt ðə ˈflaʊɚz təˈɡɛðɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那到時候我們一起數花開幾朵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is your son at home this evening?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz jɔr sʌn ət hoʊm ðɪs ˈivnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 今晚你兒子在家嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sam is at practice, back by nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /sæm ɪz ət ˈpræktɪs bæk baɪ naɪn/
dialogue.zh: Sam 去練習了，九點以前回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What sport does Sam practice?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt spɔrt dʌz sæm ˈpræktɪs/
dialogue.zh: Sam 練習的是哪一種運動？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rowing, on the river past the bridge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈroʊɪŋ ɑn ðə ˈrɪvɚ pæst ðə brɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 划船，在過了橋的那段河上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have never held a rowing oar.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ˈnɛvɚ hɛld ə ˈroʊɪŋ ɔr/
dialogue.zh: 我從來沒有握過划船的槳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sam can teach you, if you ask.
dialogue.phonetic: /sæm kæn titʃ ju ɪf ju æsk/
dialogue.zh: Sam 會教你，如果你開口問他。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I would like to try rowing once.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd laɪk tu traɪ ˈroʊɪŋ wʌns/
dialogue.zh: 我想試著去劃一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Saturday morning is his only free time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsætɚˌdeɪ ˈmɔrnɪŋ ɪz hɪz ˈoʊnli fri taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 只有週六早上他有空。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saturday works, I have no plans.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsætɚˌdeɪ wɜrks aɪ hæv noʊ plænz/
dialogue.zh: 週六可以，我沒有別的安排。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will mention it to him tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ˈmɛnʃən ɪt tu hɪm təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 今晚我就跟他提一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I do not want to bother him.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ du nɑt wɑnt tu ˈbɑðɚ hɪm/
dialogue.zh: 我不想打擾他練習。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bothering is how you become family here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɑðɚɪŋ ɪz haʊ ju bɪˈkʌm ˈfæməli hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 會互相麻煩，在這裡才算一家人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You make me feel less nervous.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju meɪk mi fil lɛs ˈnɜrvəs/
dialogue.zh: 你們讓我沒有那麼緊張了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New houses feel strange at first.
dialogue.phonetic: /nu ˈhaʊsɪz fil streɪndʒ ət fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 剛住進別人家都會覺得不對勁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This mug has a chip near the handle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs mʌɡ hæz ə tʃɪp nɪr ðə ˈhændəl/
dialogue.zh: 這個杯子靠近把手有個缺口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ray's favorite, do not tell him yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /reɪz ˈfeɪvərɪt du nɑt tɛl hɪm jɛt/
dialogue.zh: 那是 Ray 的最愛，先別跟他說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will hold your mug with care.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl hoʊld jɔr mʌɡ wɪð kɛr/
dialogue.zh: 我會小心捧著你的杯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It keeps tea hot, that is why.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kips ti hɑt ðæt ɪz waɪ/
dialogue.zh: 它保溫很好，他才會用至今。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seven forty already, on your shelf clock.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvən ˈfɔrti ɔlˈrɛdi ɑn jɔr ʃɛlf klɑk/
dialogue.zh: 看你那架子上的鐘，已經七點四十了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and your suitcase needs unpacking.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd jɔr ˈsuːkeɪs nidz ʌnˈpækiŋ/
dialogue.zh: 是啊，你的行李還空著沒拆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I see my room before I sleep?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd aɪ si maɪ rum bɪˈfɔr aɪ slip/
dialogue.zh: 睡覺前我能先看看房間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Second floor, take the first right.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛkənd flɔr teɪk ðə fɜrst raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 二樓，上去右轉第一間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Whoa, these stairs look a bit steep.
dialogue.phonetic: /woʊ ðiz stɛrz lʊk ə bɪt stip/
dialogue.zh: 哇，這樓梯看起來有點陡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold the rail, the third step creaks.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ðə reɪl ðə θɜrd stɛp kriks/
dialogue.zh: 扶好欄杆，第三級會響。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I walk softly after eleven?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ wɔk ˈsɔftli ˈæftɚ ɪˈlɛvən/
dialogue.zh: 十一點之後我要走輕一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the whole house sleeps by ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə hoʊl haʊs sleeps baɪ tɛn/
dialogue.zh: 對，十點整棟房子都睡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will be very careful up there.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl bi ˈvɛri ˈkɛrfəl ʌp ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 好，我在樓上會非常小心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The hall lamp lights the last steps.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hɔl læm laɪts ðə læst stɛps/
dialogue.zh: 走廊那盞燈會照亮最後幾級。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This door is mine, right here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs dɔr ɪz maɪn raɪt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 就是這一間門，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the key is already inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ki ɪz ɔlˈrɛdi ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 對，鑰匙已經插在門裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the window in my room big?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈwɪnˌdoʊ ɪn maɪ rum bɪɡ/
dialogue.zh: 我房間的那扇窗大嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It looks over the garden and fence.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt lʊks ˈoʊvɚ ðə ˈɡɑrdən ænd fɛns/
dialogue.zh: 可以看見花園和那道籬笆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I like that, trees are good to watch.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ laɪk ðæt triz ɑr ɡʊd tu wɑtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡，看著樹很讓人心靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bird table sits right under it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɜrd ˈteɪbəl sɪts raɪt ˈʌndɚ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 餵鳥的小台就在窗子下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Birds will wake me too early.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɜrdz wɪl weɪk mi tu ˈɜrli/
dialogue.zh: 小鳥會太早把我吵醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Close the curtain, they start at six.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊz ðə ˈkɜrtən deɪ stɑrt æt sɪks/
dialogue.zh: 拉上窗簾，牠們六點就來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six is not so bad, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ɪz nɑt soʊ bæd ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 六點其實還算還好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: School needs you up at six anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /skul nidz ju ʌp æt sɪks ˈɛniˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 反正上課也要你六點起床。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then birds are my alarm clock.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn bɜrdz ɑr maɪ əˈlɑrm klɑk/
dialogue.zh: 那小鳥就是我的鬧鐘了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And they never run out of battery.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðeɪ ˈnɛvɚ rʌn aʊt əv ˈbætəri/
dialogue.zh: 而且牠們永遠不會沒電。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I take my shoes off here?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ teɪk maɪ ʃuz ɔf hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 我的鞋子要在這裡脫掉嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please, the mat is for muddy shoes.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz ðə mæt ɪz fɔr ˈmʌdi ʃuz/
dialogue.zh: 麻煩了，腳墊就是給泥鞋踩的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My trainers are still wet from rain.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈtreɪnərz ɑr stɪl wɛt frʌm reɪn/
dialogue.zh: 我的球鞋還濕著，剛剛下雨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set them by the door, they dry fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt ðɛm baɪ ðə dɔr ðeɪ draɪ fæst/
dialogue.zh: 靠在門邊放，很快就乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the wooden rack where they go?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈwʊdən ræk wɛr ðeɪ ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 木架子就是放鞋的地方嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bottom shelf keeps them out of sight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɑtəm ʃɛlf kips ðɛm aʊt əv saɪt/
dialogue.zh: 放最下面一層就看不見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should my boots dry under the stairs?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd maɪ buʊts draɪ ˈʌndɚ ðə stɛrz/
dialogue.zh: 我的雨靴要放在樓梯下面烘嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, there is a tray for water.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðɛr ɪz ə treɪ fɔr ˈwɔtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 對，下面有個托盤接滴水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these grey slippers mine?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðiːz ɡreɪ ˈslɪpərz maɪn/
dialogue.zh: 這雙灰色拖鞋是給我的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sam wore them when he was small.
dialogue.phonetic: /sæm wɔr ðɛm wɛn hi wʌz smɔl/
dialogue.zh: Sam 小時候穿過的那雙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They are soft, my feet are happy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ɑr sɔft maɪ fit ɑr ˈhæpi/
dialogue.zh: 很軟，我的腳舒服多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wear them upstairs, the boards run cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ðɛm ˌʌpˈstɛrz ðə bɔrdz rʌn koʊld/
dialogue.zh: 樓上地板涼，穿著走剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I wear them down here too?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ wɛr ðɛm daʊn hɪr tu/
dialogue.zh: 在一樓也可以穿這雙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, just not onto the wet grass.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs dʒʌst nɑt ˈɑntu ðə wɛt ɡræs/
dialogue.zh: 可以，只是別踩到濕的草地。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your floor is clean near the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr flɔr ɪz klin nɪr ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 門口的地板也好乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ray mops the hall every Wednesday.
dialogue.phonetic: /reɪ mɑps ðə hɔl ˈɛvri ˈwɛnzˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: Ray 每週三都會拖一次玄關。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did your son bring my brown bag?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd jɔr sʌn brɪŋ maɪ braʊn bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 你兒子幫我拿回那個棕色袋子了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The driver called, Sam walked over.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈdraɪvɚ kɔld sæm wɔkt ˈoʊvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 司機打了電話，Sam 走過去取的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here it is, all my shirts inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪt ɪz ɔl maɪ ʃɜrz ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 袋子在這裡，衣服都在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, now nothing is left in taxis.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naʊ ˈnʌθɪŋ ɪz lɛft ɪn ˈtæksɪz/
dialogue.zh: 真好，這樣就沒有東西落在車上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should I leave my heavy case?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ʃʊd aɪ liv maɪ ˈhɛvi keɪs/
dialogue.zh: 我的重行李箱要擺在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The hall corner, out of the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hɔl ˈkɔrnɚ aʊt əv ðə weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 玄關那個角落，不會擋路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there room by the coat hook?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr rum baɪ ðə koʊt hʊk/
dialogue.zh: 掛外套的鉤子旁邊還有空間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slide it under the stair, it fits.
dialogue.phonetic: /slaɪd ɪt ˈʌndɚ ðə stɛr ɪt fɪts/
dialogue.zh: 推到樓梯下面，剛剛好放得下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the front door, how does it lock?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə frʌnt dɔr haʊ dʌz ɪt lɑk/
dialogue.zh: 玄關這扇門是怎麼鎖的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn the key twice, then push it.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ðə ki twaɪs ðɛn pʊʃ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 鑰匙轉兩圈，再推一下門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this the small silver key?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs ðə smɔl ˈsɪlvɚ ki/
dialogue.zh: 這一支是小小的銀色鑰匙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one opens the front door only.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn ˈoʊpənz ðə frʌnt dɔr ˈoʊnli/
dialogue.zh: 那支只開玄關這一扇門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the big brass one on the ring?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə bɪɡ bræs wʌn ɑn ðə rɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那圈上較大的黃銅鑰匙呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the side gate, near the shed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə saɪd ɡeɪt nɪr ðə ʃɛd/
dialogue.zh: 那是側門，靠近工具小屋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I keep both keys with me?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ kip boʊθ kiz wɪð mi/
dialogue.zh: 兩支鑰匙都要隨身帶著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the front door key, the tag helps.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðə frʌnt dɔr ki ðə tæɡ hɛlps/
dialogue.zh: 帶玄關那支，吊牌會提醒你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pencil, my name, right on the tag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɛnsəl maɪ neɪm raɪt ɑn ðə tæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 用鉛筆寫的名字，就在吊牌上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: If it gets lost, neighbors will call you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf ɪt ɡɛts lɔst ˈneɪbɚz wɪl kɔl ju/
dialogue.zh: 萬一掉了，鄰居會打電話給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice, a spare key stays in the kitchen?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs ə spɛr ki steɪz ɪn ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn/
dialogue.zh: 好，廚房裡還有一支備用的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one spare lives in that drawer.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wʌn spɛr lɪvz ɪn ðæt drɔr/
dialogue.zh: 有，備用那支就在那個抽屜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the side gate after dark?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ðə saɪd ɡeɪt ˈæftɚ dɑrk/
dialogue.zh: 天黑以後側門還可以用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It stays unlocked until half past ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt steɪz ʌnˈlɑkt ʌnˈtɪl hæf pæst tɛn/
dialogue.zh: 十點半以前都不用鎖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I ring the bell or knock?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ rɪŋ ðə bɛl ɔr nɑk/
dialogue.zh: 我要按門鈴還是敲門？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the bell, the knock is too loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə bɛl ðə nɑk ɪz tu laʊd/
dialogue.zh: 按鈴吧，敲門的聲音太大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two rings, or just one short ring?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu rɪŋz ɔr dʒʌst wʌn ʃɔrt rɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 按兩下，還是輕輕按一下？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One ring, if anyone is home already.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn rɪŋ ɪf ˈɛniˌwʌn ɪz hoʊm ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 如果家裡有人，按一聲就夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the letterbox, do I need one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə ˈlɛtɚˌbɑks du aɪ nid wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 信箱呢，我會有自己的一格嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the last slot, with your initials.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə læst slɑt wɪð jɔr ɪˈnɪʃəlz/
dialogue.zh: 有，最後那一格，貼了你的姓名縮寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My name starts with the letter L.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ neɪm stɑrts wɪð ðə ˈlɛtɚ ɛl/
dialogue.zh: 我的名字是 L 開頭的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The slot is marked with a small L.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə slɑt ɪz mɑrkt wɪð ə smɔl ɛl/
dialogue.zh: 那一格就貼了小小的 L。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do the rubbish bins go out?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du ðə ˈrʌbɪʃ bɪnz ɡoʊ aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 垃圾桶要什麼時候搬到外面？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tuesday night, by the side gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtuzdeɪ naɪt baɪ ðə saɪd ɡeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 週二晚上，放在側門旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I help carry them out?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ hɛlp ˈkæri ðɛm aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 我可以幫忙把桶子搬出去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sam does that, he likes the job.
dialogue.phonetic: /sæm dʌz ðæt hi laɪks ðə dʒɑb/
dialogue.zh: 那是 Sam 的事，他喜歡做。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I will leave the bins alone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl liv ðə bɪnz əˈloʊn/
dialogue.zh: 那我就不要碰那些桶子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But the green one is yours to fill.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt ðə ɡrin wʌn ɪz jɔrz tu fɪl/
dialogue.zh: 不過綠色那桶可以讓妳丟東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Glass and paper, nothing wet inside?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡlæs ænd ˈpeɪpɚ ˈnʌθɪŋ wɛt ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 只丟玻璃和紙，濕的不能丟？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, the lid must close flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ðə lɪd mʌst kloʊz flæt/
dialogue.zh: 一點不錯，蓋子要能平平闔上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the lights stay on all night?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðə laɪts steɪ ɑn ɔl naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 家裡的燈會整夜留著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the small one above the step.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ðə smɔl wʌn əˈbʌv ðə stɛp/
dialogue.zh: 只有階梯上方那一盞小燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, so I can find the stairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd soʊ aɪ kæn faɪnd ðə stɛrz/
dialogue.zh: 好，那我半夜找得到樓梯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the door stays locked from ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə dɔr steɪz lɑkt frʌm tɛn/
dialogue.zh: 大門從十點起就一直鎖著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If I come late, what do I do?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ kʌm leɪt wɑt du aɪ du/
dialogue.zh: 如果我回來晚了，該怎麼進門？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Text me first, then use the side gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛkst mi fɜrst ðɛn juz ðə saɪd ɡeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 先傳訊息給我，再走側門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is your number saved in my phone?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz jɔr ˈnʌmbɚ seɪvd ɪn maɪ foʊn/
dialogue.zh: 你的電話號碼我存進手機了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is on the fridge, under magnets.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ɑn ðə frɪdʒ ˈʌndɚ ˈmæɡnɛts/
dialogue.zh: 寫在冰箱上，壓在磁鐵下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will copy it on my palm first.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ˈkɑpi ɪt ɑn maɪ pɑm fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 我先抄在手心備著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better keep it inside your notebook.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛtɚ kip ɪt ɪnˈsaɪd jɔr ˈnoʊtˌbʊk/
dialogue.zh: 記在筆記本裡比較保險。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to close the curtains?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tu kloʊz ðə ˈkɜrtənz/
dialogue.zh: 窗簾需要我拉起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At night, if you leave the lamp on.
dialogue.phonetic: /ət naɪt ɪf ju liv ðə læm ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 晚上開著燈的話就要拉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That tall hall clock is very old.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt tɔl hɔl klɑk ɪz ˈvɛri oʊld/
dialogue.zh: 玄關那座高鐘也好舊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It needs winding on Sunday mornings.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt nidz ˈwaɪndɪŋ ɑn ˈsʌnˌdeɪ ˈmɔrnɪŋz/
dialogue.zh: 每週日早上都要上發條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I wind it, I like that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ waɪnd ɪt aɪ laɪk ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 可以讓我幫它上發條嗎？我喜歡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask Ray, he shows each new guest.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk reɪ hi ʃoʊz itʃ nu ɡɛst/
dialogue.zh: 去問 Ray，他會教每位新客人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sunday then, after the big breakfast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌnˌdeɪ ðɛn ˈæftɚ ðə bɪɡ ˈbrɛkfəst/
dialogue.zh: 那就週日，吃過豐盛早餐以後。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, he is slow and very patient.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs hi ɪz sloʊ ænd ˈvɛri ˈpeɪʃənt/
dialogue.zh: 好，他動作慢，也很有耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing, is my door lockable?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr θɪŋ ɪz maɪ dɔr ˈloʊkəbəl/
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事，我房間的門能鎖嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The knob turns, but only from outside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə nɑb tɜrnz bʌt ˈoʊnli frʌm aʊtˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 門把會轉，不過只能從外面鎖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then privacy is just the closed door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈprɪvəsi ɪz dʒʌst ðə kloʊzd dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 那關上門就有自己的空間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We knock before we come in, always.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi nɑk bɪˈfɔr wi kʌm ɪn ˈɔlweɪz/
dialogue.zh: 我們進房間前一定會先敲門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That helps a lot, thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt hɛlps ə lɑt θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 這樣我就安心多了，謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your room is ready, shall we go up?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr rum ɪz ˈrɛdi ʃæl wi ɡoʊ ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 你房間備好了，我們上樓吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First, my shoes are drying at the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst maɪ ʃuz ɑr ˈdraɪɪŋ ət ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 先等一下，我的鞋還在門口烘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They will be fine by morning light.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ wɪl bi faɪn baɪ ˈmɔrnɪŋ laɪt/
dialogue.zh: 天一亮就乾了，沒有關係。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This wet umbrella needs a corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wɛt ˌʌmˈbrɛlə nidz ə ˈkɔrnɚ/
dialogue.zh: 這把濕濕的雨傘要找個角落放。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a stand beside the mat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə stænd bɪˈsaɪd ðə mæt/
dialogue.zh: 腳墊旁邊就有一個傘架。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is dripping on the floor tile.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈdrɪpɪŋ ɑn ðə flɔr taɪl/
dialogue.zh: 它正在地板上滴水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The towel is on the lower rail.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtaʊəl ɪz ɑn ðə ˈloʊər reɪl/
dialogue.zh: 毛巾掛在下面那根橫桿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I dry my hands at the tap?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ draɪ maɪ hændz ət ðə tæp/
dialogue.zh: 我能在水龍頭那裡擦擦手嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The warm water is on the left side.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wɔrm ˈwɔtɚ ɪz ɑn ðə lɛft saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 熱水在左手邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, this sink is deeper than mine.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðɪs sɪŋk ɪz ˈdipɚ ðæn maɪn/
dialogue.zh: 喔，這個水槽比我家的深。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ray built it, he likes deep sinks.
dialogue.phonetic: /reɪ bɪlt ɪt hi laɪks dip sɪŋks/
dialogue.zh: 是 Ray 做的，他喜歡深水槽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It hides the dishes when guests come.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt haɪdz ðə ˈdɪʃɪz wɛn ɡɛsts kʌm/
dialogue.zh: 有客人時剛好蓋住沒洗的碗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very useful, since we cook a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɛri ˈjuzfəl sɪns wi kʊk ə lɑt/
dialogue.zh: 很好用，因為我們常煮東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to join the cooking?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tu dʒɔɪn ðə ˈkʊkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我一定要進廚房幫忙煮飯嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if you want, no pressure here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ɪf ju wɑnt noʊ ˈprɛʃɚ hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 想做才做，這裡沒有壓力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a relief, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ə rɪˈlif ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，這樣我鬆了一口氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Honesty suits this house very well.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnəsti suts ðɪs haʊs ˈvɛri wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 直來直往很適合這個家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I help wash up after dinner?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ hɛlp wɑʃ ʌp ˈæftɚ ˈdɪnɚ/
dialogue.zh: 晚飯以後我要幫忙洗碗嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the forks, Sam dries with a cloth.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðə fɔrks sæm draɪz wɪð ə klɔθ/
dialogue.zh: 你負責叉子，Sam 用布擦乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cloth or paper, which do you use?
dialogue.phonetic: /klɔθ ɔr ˈpeɪpɚ wɪtʃ du ju juz/
dialogue.zh: 用的是布巾還是紙巾？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cloth, washed every night in hot water.
dialogue.phonetic: /klɔθ wɑʃt ˈɛvri naɪt ɪn hɑt ˈwɔtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 是布巾，每晚都用熱水洗過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I will use it with care.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl juz ɪt wɪð kɛr/
dialogue.zh: 那我會很小心地使用它。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your room is upstairs, let us go.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr rum ɪz ˌʌpˈstɛrz lɛt ʌs ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 你房間在樓上，我們過去吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This room is bright, with one big window.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs rum ɪz braɪt wɪð wʌn bɪɡ ˈwɪnˌdoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 這間房間很亮，有一扇大窗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The blanket is wool, from Ray's aunt.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈblæŋkɪt ɪz wʊl frʌm reɪz ɑnt/
dialogue.zh: 毯子是羊毛的，Ray 的阿姨織的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is heavy, my shoulders like it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈhɛvi maɪ ˈʃoʊldɚz laɪk ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 它沉沉的，我肩膀很喜歡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You sleep better under a heavy one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju slip ˈbɛtɚ ˈʌndɚ ə ˈhɛvi wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 蓋重一點的毯子，睡得更安。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is my towel, is it on the bed?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz maɪ ˈtaʊəl ɪz ɪt ɑn ðə bɛd/
dialogue.zh: 我的毛巾在哪裡，在床上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The second towel hangs behind the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈsɛkənd ˈtaʊəl hæŋz bɪˈhaɪnd ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 第二條毛巾掛在門後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a wardrobe with three hangers.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə ˈwɔrˌdroʊb wɪθ θri ˈhæŋɡɚz/
dialogue.zh: 衣櫃裡有三個衣架。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: More hang in the hall closet, take four.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɔr hæŋ ɪn ðə hɔl ˈklɑsɪt teɪk fɔr/
dialogue.zh: 玄關儲藏室還有，你可以拿四個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should my school shirts hang or fold?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd maɪ skul ʃɜrz hæŋ ɔr foʊld/
dialogue.zh: 我的校服襯衫要吊起來還是折起來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hang the pressed one, fold the rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæŋ ðə prɛst wʌn foʊld ðə rɛst/
dialogue.zh: 燙過的吊起來，其他摺好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This drawer is empty, is it mine?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs drɔr ɪz ˈɛmpti ɪz ɪt maɪn/
dialogue.zh: 這個抽屜是空的，是我的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yours from today, for socks and shirts.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔrz frʌm təˈdeɪ fɔr sɑks ænd ʃɜrz/
dialogue.zh: 今天起是你的，放襪子和內衣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Small but steady, this desk is fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl bʌt ˈstɛdi ðɪs dɛsk ɪz faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 書桌雖然小，但是一點都不晃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The chair turns, if you need to move.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tʃɛr tɜrnz ɪf ju nid tu muv/
dialogue.zh: 椅子會轉，想轉身很方便。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this lamp for reading at night?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs læm fɔr ˈridɪŋ ət naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 這盞台燈是晚上讀書用的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the switch is under the shade.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə swɪtʃ ɪz ˈʌndɚ ðə ʃeɪd/
dialogue.zh: 對，開關在燈罩下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The light is soft, good for my eyes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə laɪt ɪz sɔft ɡʊd fɔr maɪ aɪz/
dialogue.zh: 光線很柔和，對眼睛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We keep the big lights off after nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kip ðə bɪɡ laɪts ɔf ˈæftɚ naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 九點以後我們都不開大燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the wifi, what is the name?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə ˈwaɪfaɪ wɑt ɪz ðə neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 那麼無線網路，名字是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is Whitfield Guest, the second one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈwɪtˌfid ɡɛst ðə ˈsɛkənd wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 是 Whitfield Guest，列表裡第二個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the password, may I ask you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə ˈpæswɜrd meɪ aɪ æsk ju/
dialogue.zh: 密碼呢，我可以問你嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is on the card beside your lamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ɑn ðə kɑrd bɪˈsaɪd jɔr læm/
dialogue.zh: 寫在你台燈旁邊那張卡片上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found it, four words with one dash.
dialogue.phonetic: /faʊnd ɪt fɔr wɜrdz wɪθ wʌn dæʃ/
dialogue.zh: 找到了，四個字中間有一道橫線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Copy it carefully, the letters matter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɑpi ɪt ˈkɛrfəli ðə ˈlɛtɚz ˈmætɚ/
dialogue.zh: 請慢慢抄，字母要寫對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Connected, the bars are full here.
dialogue.phonetic: /kəˈnɛktɪd ðə bɑrz ɑr fʊl hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 連上了，訊號在這裡是滿格。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, the router sits above the fridge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðə ˈrutɚ sɪts əˈbʌv ðə frɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 真好，分享器就放在冰箱上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the signal weaker in my room?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈsɪɡnəl ˈwikɚ ɪn maɪ rum/
dialogue.zh: 我房間的網路會比較弱嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not here, only in the back garden.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt hɪr ˈoʊnli ɪn ðə bæk ˈɡɑrdən/
dialogue.zh: 這裡不會，只有後面的花園較弱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone shows full bars, perfect.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ foʊn ʃoʊz fʊl bɑrz ˈpɜrfɪkt/
dialogue.zh: 我的手機顯示滿格，太完美了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then video calls will not freeze.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈvɪdioʊ kɔlz wɪl nɑt friz/
dialogue.zh: 那視訊通話就不會卡住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I call home this evening?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ kɔl hoʊm ðɪs ˈivnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 今天晚上我可以打回家嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, before ten, the house is calm.
dialogue.phonetic: /əv kɔrs bɪˈfɔr tɛn ðə haʊs ɪz kɑm/
dialogue.zh: 當然可以，十點前，屋子也安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My mother worries until I ring.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈmʌðɚ ˈwɜriz ʌnˈtɪl aɪ rɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我媽媽一定要接到電話才放心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She will love the garden you describe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi wɪl lʌv ðə ˈɡɑrdən ju dɪsˈkraɪb/
dialogue.zh: 她會喜歡你描述的那個花園。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I download the local bus app?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ ˈdaʊnˌlod ðə ˈloʊkəl bʌs æp/
dialogue.zh: 我該把當地的公車應用下載下來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, Sam uses it every day.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs sæm ˈjuzɪz ɪt ˈɛvri deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 要，Sam 每天都在用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it asks for my school stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɪt æsks fɔr maɪ skul stɑp/
dialogue.zh: 現在它問我學校那一站。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pick Bridge Road, the third one.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɪk brɪdʒ roʊd ðə θɜrd wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 選 Bridge Road，第三站。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that bus late in the morning?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt bʌs leɪt ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 早上的公車會不會晚點？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rarely, it runs every twelve minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɛrli ɪt rʌnz ˈɛvri twɛlv ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 很少遲到，十二分鐘一班。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My laptop needs the long cable.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈlæpˌtɑp nidz ðə lɔŋ ˈkeɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 我的筆電需要那條長充電線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the desk drawer, next to the mouse.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðə dɛsk drɔr nɛkst tu ðə maʊs/
dialogue.zh: 在書桌抽屜裡，滑鼠旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I leave it open on the bed?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ liv ɪt ˈoʊpən ɑn ðə bɛd/
dialogue.zh: 我可以讓它開著放在床上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better on the desk, heat is bad.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛtɚ ɑn ðə dɛsk hit ɪz bæd/
dialogue.zh: 放書桌上比較好，熱對它不好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is one plug beside the desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz wʌn plʌɡ bɪˈsaɪd ðə dɛsk/
dialogue.zh: 書桌旁邊有一個插座。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The strip under it gives three more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə strɪp ˈʌndɚ ɪt ɡɪvz θri mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 桌下那條延長線還有三個洞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I switch anything off at night?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ swɪtʃ ˈɛniˌθɪŋ ɔf ət naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 晚上我要關掉什麼東西嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the desk lamp, the rest can stay.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ðə dɛsk læm ðə rɛst kæn steɪ/
dialogue.zh: 只有書桌燈，其他的可以留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the heating on in this room?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈhitɪŋ ɑn ɪn ðɪs rum/
dialogue.zh: 這一間有暖氣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It warms up at six in the morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wɔrmz ʌp æt sɪks ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 早上六點會自動變暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Listen, the radiator clicks a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɪsən ðə ˈreɪˌdɪeɪtɚ klɪks ə ˈlɪtəl/
dialogue.zh: 你聽，暖氣片會輕輕喀喀響。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is normal, it stops by eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ˈnɔrməl ɪt stɑps baɪ eɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那是正常的，八點就不響了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One blanket is enough, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈblæŋkɪt ɪz ɪˈnʌf aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 一條毯子就夠了，我想。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep the extra quilt in the closet.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðə ˈɛkstrə kwɪlt ɪn ðə ˈklɑsɪt/
dialogue.zh: 多的一條被子放在儲藏櫃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a mirror on the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə ˈmɪrɚ ɑn ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 櫃門上有一面鏡子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It helps with your tie in the rush.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hɛlps wɪð jɔr taɪ ɪn ðə rʌʃ/
dialogue.zh: 出門趕時間時，繫領帶很方便。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The shelf holds six of my books.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ʃɛlf hoʊldz sɪks əv maɪ bʊks/
dialogue.zh: 書架放得下我的六本書。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The top shelf is yours, with the clock.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tɑp ʃɛlf ɪz jɔrz wɪð ðə klɑk/
dialogue.zh: 最上面那層是你的，還有小鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I put my water bottle here?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ pʊt maɪ ˈwɔtɚ ˈbɑtəl hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 我的水杯可以放這裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The round table by the window.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə raʊnd ˈteɪbəl baɪ ðə ˈwɪnˌdoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 放窗邊那張圓桌就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice, this window has a screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs ðɪs ˈwɪnˌdoʊ hæz ə skrin/
dialogue.zh: 真好，這扇窗有紗窗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open it at night, close by nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ɪt ət naɪt kloʊz baɪ naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 晚上可以開，九點關起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are there mosquitoes out at night?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðɛr ˌmɑskəˈtoʊz aʊt ət naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 晚上的外面會有蚊子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very few, the garden birds eat them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɛri fju ðə ˈɡɑrdən bɜrdz it ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 很少，花園裡的鳥會吃掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the floor a good place for bags?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə flɔr ə ɡʊd pleɪs fɔr bæɡz/
dialogue.zh: 地板適合放我的袋子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set yours on the bed, it is stronger.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt jɔrz ɑn ðə bɛd ɪt ɪz ˈstrɔŋɡɚ/
dialogue.zh: 放在床上吧，床比較撐得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time should I be downstairs?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt taɪm ʃʊd aɪ bi ˌdaʊnˈstɛrz/
dialogue.zh: 我幾點要到樓下？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seven thirty, breakfast waits on the table.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvən ˈθɜrdi ˈbrɛkfəst weɪts ɑn ðə ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 七點半，早餐會擺在桌上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seven thirty is early for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvən ˈθɜrdi ɪz ˈɜrli fɔr mi/
dialogue.zh: 七點半對我而言算早。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Toast waits for nobody, trust me.
dialogue.phonetic: /toʊst weɪts fɔr ˈnoʊˌbɑdi trʌst mi/
dialogue.zh: 烤吐司可不等人，相信我的話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a clock radio, old style.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə klɑk ˈreɪʃiˌoʊ oʊld staɪl/
dialogue.zh: 這裡有一台舊式鐘型收音機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ray listens at noon, news only.
dialogue.phonetic: /reɪ ˈlɪsənz ət nun nuz ˈoʊnli/
dialogue.zh: Ray 只在中午聽新聞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I play music in my room?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ pleɪ ˈmjuzɪk ɪn maɪ rum/
dialogue.zh: 我可以在房間裡聽音樂嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Earphones only, after eight, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɪrfoʊnz ˈoʊnli ˈæftɚ eɪt pliz/
dialogue.zh: 八點以後請戴耳機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have earphones, one pair is enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ˈɪrˌfoʊnz wʌn pɛr ɪz ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 我帶了耳機，一組就夠用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it low, the walls are thin.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ɪt loʊ ðə wɔlz ɑr θɪn/
dialogue.zh: 音量小一點，牆壁很薄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thin walls, so I can hear Sam?
dialogue.phonetic: /θɪn wɔlz soʊ aɪ kæn hɪr sæm/
dialogue.zh: 牆這麼薄，所以我會聽到 Sam？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He snores a little, poor boy.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi snɔrz ə ˈlɪtəl pʊr bɔɪ/
dialogue.zh: 他睡覺會打呼，可憐的男孩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This room already feels like mine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs rum ɔlˈrɛdi filz laɪk maɪn/
dialogue.zh: 這間房間已經有點像我的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it a week, you are halfway.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv ɪt ə wik ju ɑr ˈhæfˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 再給你一週，你已經適應一半了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I made the bed, look at it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ meɪd ðə bɛd lʊk ət ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我把床鋪好了，你看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Corners so tight, who taught you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɔrnɚz soʊ taɪt hu tɔt ju/
dialogue.zh: 床角拉得好緊，誰教你鋪的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My uniform is on the hanger.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈjunəˌfɔrm ɪz ɑn ðə ˈhæŋɡɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我的校服已經吊在衣架上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tie hangs right beside your coat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə taɪ hæŋz raɪt bɪˈsaɪd jɔr koʊt/
dialogue.zh: 領帶就掛在外套旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do my dirty clothes go?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du maɪ ˈdɜrti kloʊz ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我髒的衣服要丟進哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The hamper waits by the bathroom door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈhæmpɚ weɪts baɪ ðə ˈbæθˌrum dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 洗衣籃就在浴室門口等著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is washing done here or at a shop?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ˈwɑʃɪŋ dʌn hɪr ɔr æt ə ʃɑp/
dialogue.zh: 衣服是在家裡洗，還是外送？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, every Wednesday, big loads only.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ˈɛvri ˈwɛnzˌdeɪ bɪɡ loʊdz ˈoʊnli/
dialogue.zh: 在家洗，每週三，一次洗很多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I pay for the machine use?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ peɪ fɔr ðə məˈʃin juz/
dialogue.zh: 用洗衣機我要付錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, three loads each week are free.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ θri loʊdz itʃ wik ɑr fri/
dialogue.zh: 不用，一週三次都免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then my blue shirt can join.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn maɪ blu ʃɜrt kæn dʒɔɪn/
dialogue.zh: 那我的藍襯衫也能一起洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cold water keeps the color nice.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld ˈwɔtɚ kips ðə ˈkʌlɚ naɪs/
dialogue.zh: 用冷水洗，顏色才會漂亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The chair is soft, I will sit down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tʃɛr ɪz sɔft aɪ wɪl sɪt daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 椅子很軟，我先坐下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stay, I have time tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /steɪ aɪ hæv taɪm təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 坐著吧，我今晚有空。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you need this room some nights?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju nid ðɪs rum sʌm naɪts/
dialogue.zh: 偶爾你們會需要用這間房嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never, it is yours the whole year.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvɚ ɪt ɪz jɔrz ðə hoʊl jɪr/
dialogue.zh: 不會，一整年都是你的房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will unpack my books now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ʌnˈpæk maɪ bʊks naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我現在要把書拿出來整理。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And I will leave water by you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd aɪ wɪl liv ˈwɔtɚ baɪ ju/
dialogue.zh: 我會幫你放一杯水在旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You thought of everything tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju θɔt əv ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 今晚你把每件事都想到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One week in, you will feel at home.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn wik ɪn ju wɪl fil ət hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 住滿一週，你就會像在自己家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the upstairs bath free after nine?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˌʌpˈstɛrz bæθ fri ˈæftɚ naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 樓上的浴室九點以後是空的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, Sam is done by eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs sæm ɪz dʌn baɪ eɪt/
dialogue.zh: 對，Sam 八點就洗完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that the only time I can wash?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ði ˈoʊnli taɪm aɪ kæn wɑʃ/
dialogue.zh: 那是唯一能洗澡的時間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any time after eight, it is yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni taɪm ˈæftər eɪt ɪt ɪz jɔrz/
dialogue.zh: 八點以後任何時間都給你用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which bathroom should I use tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈbæθˌrum ʃʊd aɪ juz təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 今晚我應該用哪一間浴室？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The small one, the big is Ray's.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə smɔl wʌn ðə bɪɡ ɪz reɪz/
dialogue.zh: 小的那間，大的那間是 Ray 的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long is a fair shower here?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ ɪz ə fɛr ˈʃaʊɚ hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡沖澡多久算剛好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten minutes is fair, twenty is long.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈmɪnɪts ɪz fɛr ˈtwɛnti ɪz lɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 十分鐘剛好，二十分鐘太久了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the hot water last long?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə hɑt ˈwɔtɚ læst lɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 熱水的量撐得久嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It stays hot for thirty minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt steɪz hɑt fɔr ˈθɜrdi ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 可以維持三十分鐘的熱度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I run the tap first?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ rʌn ðə tæp fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 我要先讓水龍頭流一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten seconds, until the water turns hot.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈsɛkəndz ʌnˈtɪl ðə ˈwɔtɚ tɜrnz hɑt/
dialogue.zh: 十秒就好，等水變熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my towel on that warm rail?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz maɪ ˈtaʊəl ɑn ðæt wɔrm reɪl/
dialogue.zh: 我的毛巾掛在那根暖桿上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two hang there, the rail heats them both.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu hæŋ ðɛr ðə reɪl hits ðɛm boʊθ/
dialogue.zh: 掛了兩條，桿子把它們都烘暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm towels are a lovely thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm ˈtaʊəlz ɑr ə ˈlʌvli θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 暖呼呼的毛巾真是件美好的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ray fitted it two winters ago.
dialogue.phonetic: /reɪ ˈfɪtɪd ɪt tu ˈwɪntɚz əˈɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 那是 Ray 兩年前裝好的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I take a bath tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ teɪk ə bæθ təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 今天晚上我可以泡澡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please, but the plug needs a turn.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz bʌt ðə plʌɡ nidz ə tɜrn/
dialogue.zh: 可以，不過塞子要轉一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the bath plug hard to fit?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə bæθ plʌɡ hɑrd tu fɪt/
dialogue.zh: 浴缸的塞子很難蓋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn it left, then it holds water.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ɪt lɛft ðɛn ɪt hoʊldz ˈwɔtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 往左轉，水就留住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much water should the tub hold?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ˈwɔtɚ ʃʊd ðə tʌb hoʊld/
dialogue.zh: 浴缸大概要放多少水？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half is plenty, do not fill it.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ɪz ˈplɛnti du nɑt fɪl ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 一半就夠，不用放滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to watch the water use?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tu wɑtʃ ðə ˈwɔtɚ juz/
dialogue.zh: 我用水要特別節制嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only in summer, the garden drinks much.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ɪn ˈsʌmɚ ðə ˈɡɑrdən drɪŋks mʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 只有夏天，花園很會喝水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, the shower curtain is very long.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ ðə ˈʃaʊɚ ˈkɜrtən ɪz ˈvɛri lɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 哇，這道淋浴簾好長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tuck it inside, or the floor gets wet.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʌk ɪt ɪnˈsaɪd ɔr ðə flɔr ɡɛts wɛt/
dialogue.zh: 簾子往內收，不然地板會濕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My feet are slipping a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ fit ɑr ˈslɪpɪŋ ə ˈlɪtəl/
dialogue.zh: 我的腳有點在打滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the mat, it has grip.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə mæt ɪt hæz ɡrɪp/
dialogue.zh: 踩那塊墊子，它會抓地。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the floor warm here at night?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə flɔr wɔrm hɪr ət naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 晚上樓上這塊地板會暖嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It heats from six until morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hits frʌm sɪks ʌnˈtɪl ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 從六點一路暖到早上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold tiles wake me too fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld ˈtaɪləz weɪk mi tu fæst/
dialogue.zh: 冰涼的磁磚會一下把我吵醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your slippers wait beside the tub.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr ˈslɪpɚz weɪt bɪˈsaɪd ðə tʌb/
dialogue.zh: 你的拖鞋就在浴缸旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a small fan in here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə smɔl fæn ɪn hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 這個浴室裡有一台小風扇。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Switch it on, it clears the mirror.
dialogue.phonetic: /swɪtʃ ɪt ɑn ɪt klɪrz ðə ˈmɪrɚ/
dialogue.zh: 打開它，鏡子就不會起霧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My mirror is foggy already.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈmɪrɚ ɪz ˈfɔɡi ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 我的鏡子已經一片霧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give the fan two minutes, wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv ðə fæn tu ˈmɪnɪts weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 讓風扇吹兩分鐘，等一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the hair dryer in this drawer?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə hɛr ˈdraɪər ɪn ðɪs drɔr/
dialogue.zh: 吹風機在這一格抽屜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Under the sink, with spare light bulbs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndɚ ðə sɪŋk wɪð spɛr laɪt bʌlbz/
dialogue.zh: 水槽下面，跟備用燈泡一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The dryer is loud, is that normal?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈdraɪər ɪz laʊd ɪz ðæt ˈnɔrməl/
dialogue.zh: 吹風機好大聲，這正常嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old motor, but it dries quickly.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊld ˈmoʊtɚ bʌt ɪt draɪz ˈkwɪkli/
dialogue.zh: 馬達舊了，不過吹得很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I dry my hair after ten?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ draɪ maɪ hɛr ˈæftɚ tɛn/
dialogue.zh: 十點以後我還可以吹頭髮嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please wait till morning, sound travels up.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz weɪt tɪl ˈmɔrnɪŋ saʊnd ˈtrævəlz ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 請留到早上，聲音會往上傳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pipes knock when the water stops.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə paɪps nɑk wɛn ðə ˈwɔtɚ stɑps/
dialogue.zh: 水一停，水管就喀喀響。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that is the water pressure.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðæt ɪz ðə ˈwɔtɚ ˈprɛʃɚ/
dialogue.zh: 對，那是水壓在作怪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I worry about that knocking?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ ˈwɜri əˈbaʊt ðæt ˈnɑkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那個敲擊聲要擔心嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not at all, the pipes are strong.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ət ɔl ðə paɪps ɑr strɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 完全不用，管線很結實。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I rinse the bath when I finish?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ rɪns ðə bæθ wɛn aɪ ˈfɪnɪʃ/
dialogue.zh: 泡完我要沖一下浴缸嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A quick rinse, then hang your towel.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə kwɪk rɪns ðɛn hæŋ jɔr ˈtaʊəl/
dialogue.zh: 簡單沖一沖，再把毛巾掛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does the wet towel go?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr dʌz ðə wɛt ˈtaʊəl ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 濕毛巾要掛到哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Back on the rail, the hook beside you.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk ɑn ðə reɪl ðə hʊk bɪˈsaɪd ju/
dialogue.zh: 掛回暖桿，鉤子就在你手邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I use my own soap?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ juz maɪ oʊn soʊp/
dialogue.zh: 我可以用自己帶的肥皂嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better, the guest soap itches a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛtɚ ðə ɡɛst soʊp ˈɪtʃɪz ə bɪt/
dialogue.zh: 自己的比較好，備用皂會癢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nearly empty, this shampoo bottle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɪrli ˈɛmpti ðɪs ʃæmˈpu ˈbɑtəl/
dialogue.zh: 洗髮精這瓶子快要空了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A new one waits in the cupboard.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə nu wʌn weɪts ɪn ðə ˈkʌbɚd/
dialogue.zh: 新的一瓶在櫥櫃裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I write down what I finish?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ raɪt daʊn wɑt aɪ ˈfɪnɪʃ/
dialogue.zh: 用完的東西我要寫下來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, on the list, we buy more.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɑn ðə lɪst wi baɪ mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 要，寫在清單上，我們會補。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I turn the little latch?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ tɜrn ðə ˈlɪtəl lætʃ/
dialogue.zh: 那個小門閂我可以轉嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gently, it sticks when the air is damp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdʒɛntli ɪt stɪks wɛn ði ɛr ɪz dæmp/
dialogue.zh: 輕輕轉，空氣潮的時候會卡住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the latch break easily?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə lætʃ breɪk ˈizəli/
dialogue.zh: 這個門閂容易壞嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Treat it soft and it lasts years.
dialogue.phonetic: /trit ɪt sɔft ænd ɪt læsts jɪrz/
dialogue.zh: 對它溫柔，它就能用多年。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is Sam waiting to shower tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz sæm ˈweɪtɪŋ tu ˈʃaʊɚ təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: Sam 今晚正等著洗澡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He is at the library, home at nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi ɪz ət ðə ˈlaɪˌbɛri hoʊm æt naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 他在圖書館，九點才回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I will not hurry much.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl nɑt ˈhɜri mʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 那我就不用急著洗完。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He texted that he is not sweaty.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi ˈtɛkstɪd ðæt hi ɪz nɑt ˈswɛti/
dialogue.zh: 他傳訊息說他現在也不流汗了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the water strong up here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈwɔtɚ strɔŋ ʌp hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 樓上的水壓夠強嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Strongest on the second floor, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstrɔŋɪst ɑn ðə ˈsɛkənd flɔr ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，這一層水壓最強。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The spray hits my shoulders well.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə spreɪ hɪts maɪ ˈʃoʊldɚz wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 水柱打在我肩膀上很舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ray fixed the head last month.
dialogue.phonetic: /reɪ fɪkst ðə hɛd læst mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 上個月 Ray 剛修好蓮蓬頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I have bubbles in my bath?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ hæv ˈbʌbəlz ɪn maɪ bæθ/
dialogue.zh: 我的浴缸可以加泡泡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Friday is bubble night, if you like.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfraɪˌdeɪ ɪz ˈbʌbəl naɪt ɪf ju laɪk/
dialogue.zh: 週五是泡泡夜，如果你願意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bubble night sounds wonderful to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbʌbəl naɪt saʊndz ˈwʌndɚfəl tu mi/
dialogue.zh: 泡泡夜聽起來太好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use a little, the tub needs rinsing.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ə ˈlɪtəl ðə tʌb nidz ˈrɪnsɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 倒少一點，浴缸要沖很久。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time do you wash, usually?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt taɪm du ju wɑʃ ˈjuʒuəli/
dialogue.zh: 妳平常都幾點洗澡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six, before the day gets busy.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks bɪˈfɔr ðə deɪ ɡɛts ˈbɪzi/
dialogue.zh: 六點，趁一天還不太忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six is my hour, too.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ɪz maɪ ˈaʊər tu/
dialogue.zh: 六點也是我洗澡的時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you will find me there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ju wɪl faɪnd mi ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 那你會在那裡遇到我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we share the small bathroom?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi ʃɛr ðə smɔl ˈbæθˌrum/
dialogue.zh: 所以我們共用小的那間？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You go first, I finish early.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɡoʊ fɜrst aɪ ˈfɪnɪʃ ˈɜrli/
dialogue.zh: 你先洗，我很早就洗完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is easy, no waiting at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ˈizi noʊ ˈweɪtɪŋ ət ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 這樣很輕鬆，都不用等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Except Sunday, the house washes late.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈsɛpt ˈsʌnˌdeɪ ðə haʊs ˈwɑʃɪz leɪt/
dialogue.zh: 只有週日，大家都洗得晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sunday I will sleep until eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌnˌdeɪ aɪ wɪl slip ʌnˈtɪl eɪt/
dialogue.zh: 週日我會一路睡到八點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bath is yours until ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bæθ ɪz jɔrz ʌnˈtɪl tɛn/
dialogue.zh: 十點以前浴缸都是你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the boiler noisy at night?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈbɔɪlər ˈnɔɪzi ət naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 熱水爐夜裡會不會吵？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A soft hum, behind the kitchen door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə sɔft hʌm bɪˈhaɪnd ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 只有輕輕的嗡嗡聲，在廚房門後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I did hear a hum, yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ dɪd hɪr ə hʌm jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 我確實聽到一聲嗡嗡，是的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is it, it heats the water.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ɪt ɪt hits ðə ˈwɔtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 就是那個，它在把水加熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I use the warm bath mat?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ juz ðə wɔrm bæθ mæt/
dialogue.zh: 那一塊浴室墊我也可以踩嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is yours, at the stair top.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz jɔrz ət ðə stɛr tɑp/
dialogue.zh: 那是給你用的，在樓梯口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The toothpaste tube is empty again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtuθˌpeɪst tub ɪz ˈɛmpti əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 牙膏又被我用完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A new tube on the shelf, take two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə nu tub ɑn ðə ʃɛlf teɪk tu/
dialogue.zh: 架子上有新的，拿兩條無妨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I buy my own toothbrush?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ baɪ maɪ oʊn ˈtuθˌbrʌʃ/
dialogue.zh: 牙刷要我自己買嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I bought one, in your drawer, blue.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ bɔt wʌn ɪn jɔr drɔr blu/
dialogue.zh: 我買了，放在你抽屜，藍色的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You remembered my color, so kind.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju rɪˈmɛmbɚd maɪ ˈkʌlɚ soʊ kaɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 你記得我喜歡的顏色，真體貼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue suits you, Sam argued for green.
dialogue.phonetic: /blu suts ju sæm ˈɑrɡjud fɔr ɡrin/
dialogue.zh: 藍色合你，Sam 原本堅持綠色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if the water suddenly turns cold?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt ɪf ðə ˈwɔtɚ ˈsʌdənli tɜrnz koʊld/
dialogue.zh: 要是水突然變涼怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell me at once, Ray knows the fix.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl mi ət wʌns reɪ noʊz ðə fɪks/
dialogue.zh: 立刻告訴我，Ray 知道怎麼修。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I will knock twice, softly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl nɑk twaɪs ˈsɔftli/
dialogue.zh: 那我就輕輕敲兩下門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Knock twice, I sleep across the hall.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑk twaɪs aɪ slip əˈkrɔs ðə hɔl/
dialogue.zh: 敲兩下就好，我睡在走廊對面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine it is, my bath is ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ɪt ɪz maɪ bæθ ɪz ˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 那就九點，我的水放好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enjoy it, the house is quiet now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ɪt ðə haʊs ɪz ˈkwaɪət naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢泡，屋裡現在很安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can smell toast from the stair.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn smɛl toʊst frʌm ðə stɛr/
dialogue.zh: 我在樓梯口就聞到吐司香。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the kettle, it boiled already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə ˈkɛtl ɪt bɔɪld ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 那是水壺，水已經滾了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my seat the one by the window?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz maɪ sit ðə wʌn baɪ ðə ˈwɪnˌdoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我的位子是靠窗那一個嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, your name is on a small card.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs jɔr neɪm ɪz ɑn ə smɔl kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 對，你的名字寫在小卡片上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is in the bowl, oats or cornflakes?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt ɪz ɪn ðə boʊl oʊts ɔr ˈkɔrnˌfleɪks/
dialogue.zh: 碗裡是燕麥還是玉米片？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rolled oats with honey, Ray's habit.
dialogue.phonetic: /roʊld oʊts wɪð ˈhʌni reɪz ˈhæbɪt/
dialogue.zh: 是燕麥片加蜂蜜，Ray 的習慣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I help myself to the milk?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ hɛlp maɪˈsɛlf tu ðə mɪlk/
dialogue.zh: 牛奶我可以自己倒嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Help yourself, it is in the door shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɛlp jɔrˈsɛlf ɪt ɪz ɪn ðə dɔr ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 自己倒就好，就在冰箱門那一格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the toaster safe for my hands?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈtoʊstɚ seɪf fɔr maɪ hændz/
dialogue.zh: 烤麵包機對我的手安全嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the wooden fork, never metal.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə ˈwʊdən fɔrk ˈnɛvɚ ˈmɛtəl/
dialogue.zh: 用木叉子，絕對不要用鐵的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My toast is light brown, just right.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ toʊst ɪz laɪt braʊn dʒʌst raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我的吐司是淺棕色，剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Butter first, then jam, that is the order.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbʌtɚ fɜrst ðɛn dʒæm ðæt ɪz ði ˈɔrdɚ/
dialogue.zh: 先抹奶油再抹果醬，這是順序。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which jam is yours, strawberry or plum?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ dʒæm ɪz jɔrz ˈstrɔˌbɛri ɔr plʌm/
dialogue.zh: 你吃哪一種果醬，草莓還是梅子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plum, Ray made it from the back tree.
dialogue.phonetic: /plʌm reɪ meɪd ɪt frʌm ðə bæk tri/
dialogue.zh: 梅子的，Ray 用後面那棵樹做的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tree jam, that is new to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /tri dʒæm ðæt ɪz nu tu mi/
dialogue.zh: 自家樹上的果醬，我第一次聽說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two jars are yours to take home.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu dʒɑrz ɑr jɔrz tu teɪk hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 有兩罐可以讓你帶回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I have tea with the milk here?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ hæv ti wɪð ðə mɪlk hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 我可以在這裡喝加奶的茶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bigger cup is yours, it is chipped.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈbɪɡɚ kʌp ɪz jɔrz ɪt ɪz tʃɪpt/
dialogue.zh: 那杯大一點的是你的，有缺口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ray's chipped mug is here, I found it.
dialogue.phonetic: /reɪz tʃɪpt mʌɡ ɪz hɪr aɪ faʊnd ɪt/
dialogue.zh: Ray 那只有缺口的杯子在這裡，我找到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He will be glad you chose it.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi wɪl bi ɡlæd ju tʃoʊz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 他會高興你選了它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you fry eggs on weekdays?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju fraɪ ɛɡz ɑn ˈwikˌdeɪz/
dialogue.zh: 你們平常日會煎蛋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only Sunday, weekdays are boiled or none.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ˈsʌnˌdeɪ ˈwikˌdeɪz ɑr bɔɪld ɔr nʌn/
dialogue.zh: 只有週日，平常日是水煮蛋或不吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Boiled eggs take four minutes, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /bɔɪld ɛɡz teɪk fɔr ˈmɪnɪts raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 水煮蛋只要四分鐘，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The blue timer on the fridge does it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə blu ˈtaɪmɚ ɑn ðə frɪdʒ dʌz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 冰箱上那個藍色計時器會算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I would like one egg and toast.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd laɪk wʌn ɛɡ ænd toʊst/
dialogue.zh: 我想要一顆蛋和一片吐司。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One egg, two slices, that is Sam's size.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ɛɡ tu ˈslaɪsɪz ðæt ɪz sæmz saɪz/
dialogue.zh: 一顆蛋、兩片吐司，那是 Sam 的份量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How big is Sam's breakfast usually?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ bɪɡ ɪz sæmz ˈbrɛkfəst ˈjuʒuəli/
dialogue.zh: Sam 的早餐通常吃多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three eggs, if he wakes early.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ɛɡz ɪf hi weɪks ˈɜrli/
dialogue.zh: 三顆蛋，如果他醒得早。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there fruit on this table?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr frut ɑn ðɪs ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 這張桌上有水果嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: An apple basket, take the red one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ən ˈæpəl ˈbæskɪt teɪk ðə rɛd wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 一籃蘋果，拿那顆紅的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The apple is crisp, my teeth like it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈæpəl ɪz krɪsp maɪ θit laɪk ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 這顆蘋果好脆，我的牙齒喜歡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ray's tree again, autumn brings plenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /reɪz tri əˈɡɛn ˈɔtəm brɪŋz ˈplɛnti/
dialogue.zh: 又是那棵樹，秋天結很多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Orange juice or water in the morning?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔrɪndʒ dʒus ɔr ˈwɔtɚ ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 早上要喝柳橙汁還是水？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both stand ready, the jug is marked.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ stænd ˈrɛdi ðə dʒʌɡ ɪz mɑrkt/
dialogue.zh: 兩壺都備好了，壺身有寫名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to pay for breakfast?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tu peɪ fɔr ˈbrɛkfəst/
dialogue.zh: 早餐我需要另外付錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it is inside the weekly rent.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɪt ɪz ɪnˈsaɪd ðə ˈwikli rɛnt/
dialogue.zh: 不用，已經算在週租裡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I will eat the second toast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl it ðə ˈsɛkənd toʊst/
dialogue.zh: 那我要吃第二片吐司。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eat three, school starts far away.
dialogue.phonetic: /it θri skul stɑrts fɑr əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 吃三片也沒關係，學校很遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pack a lunch for noon?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ pæk ə lʌntʃ fɔr nun/
dialogue.zh: 我可以自備午餐嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the box is in the lower cupboard.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə bɑks ɪz ɪn ðə ˈloʊər ˈkʌbɚd/
dialogue.zh: 可以，餐盒在下面那個櫥櫃裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What goes well in a lunch box?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt ɡoʊz wɛl ɪn ə lʌntʃ bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 餐盒裡裝什麼比較好呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cheese, a tomato, and bread sticks.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃiz ə təˈmeɪtoʊ ænd brɛd stɪks/
dialogue.zh: 起司、一顆番茄，還有麵包條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I take cheese from the shelf?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ teɪk tʃiz frʌm ðə ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 我可以從架上拿起司嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The wrapped half is yours to use.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ræpt hæf ɪz jɔrz tu juz/
dialogue.zh: 包著的那一半是給你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want me to wash the box?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju wɑnt mi tu wɑʃ ðə bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 你要我把餐盒洗乾淨嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rinse it, then Sam will dry it.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪns ɪt ðɛn sæm wɪl draɪ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 沖一沖就好，之後 Sam 會擦乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold on, the spoon drawer sticks again.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɑn ðə spun drɔr stɪks əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 等一下，放湯匙的抽屜又卡住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lift it slightly, then pull hard.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪft ɪt ˈslaɪtli ðɛn pʊl hɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 稍微往上提，再用力拉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is my napkin, folded nicely.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz maɪ ˈnæpkɪn ˈfoʊldɪd ˈnaɪsli/
dialogue.zh: 我的餐巾在這裡，折得好整齊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Paper ones are in the tin, help yourself.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪpɚ wʌnz ɑr ɪn ðə tɪn hɛlp jɔrˈsɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 紙餐巾在鐵罐裡，自己拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sugar in your tea, Ray asked?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃʊɡɚ ɪn jɔr ti reɪ æskt/
dialogue.zh: 你的茶要加糖嗎？Ray 之前問過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He takes none, one spoon is plenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi teɪks nʌn wʌn spun ɪz ˈplɛnti/
dialogue.zh: 他都不加，一勺就太甜了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honey suits my toast better, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhʌni suts maɪ toʊst ˈbɛtɚ aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 我想蜂蜜配我的吐司比較好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The jar is the tall one, near the window.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dʒɑr ɪz ðə tɔl wʌn nɪr ðə ˈwɪnˌdoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 蜂蜜罐是窗邊那個高高的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Newspaper at breakfast, is that here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnuzˌpeɪpɚ ət ˈbrɛkfəst ɪz ðæt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 吃早餐會看報，這裡也有嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ray reads it, you may see the weather page.
dialogue.phonetic: /reɪ ridz ɪt ju meɪ si ðə ˈwɛðɚ peɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: Ray 會看，你可以翻天氣那一頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rain tomorrow, so I need my coat.
dialogue.phonetic: /reɪn təˈmɑroʊ soʊ aɪ nid maɪ koʊt/
dialogue.zh: 明天會下雨，所以我需要外套。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The umbrella stand is by the mat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˌʌmˈbrɛlə stænd ɪz baɪ ðə mæt/
dialogue.zh: 傘架就在門墊旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is coffee allowed for a student?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ˈkɔfi əˈlaʊd fɔr ə ˈstjudənt/
dialogue.zh: 學生也可以喝咖啡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One small cup, with much milk.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn smɔl kʌp wɪð mʌtʃ mɪlk/
dialogue.zh: 一小杯就好，多加牛奶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The milk makes it taste soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə mɪlk meɪks ɪt teɪst sɔft/
dialogue.zh: 加了牛奶味道就溫和了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sam drinks it black, strange boy.
dialogue.phonetic: /sæm drɪŋks ɪt blæk streɪndʒ bɔɪ/
dialogue.zh: Sam 喝黑咖啡，奇怪的男孩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This plate is empty, where does it go?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs pleɪt ɪz ˈɛmpti wɛr dʌz ɪt ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我的盤子吃完了，要放到哪裡去？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tray, beside the sink, no stacking.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə treɪ bɪˈsaɪd ðə sɪŋk noʊ ˈstækɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 放托盤上，水槽旁邊，不要疊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I wash my own cup here?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ wɑʃ maɪ oʊn kʌp hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 我自己的杯子要在這裡洗嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave it, mornings belong to the bus.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv ɪt ˈmɔrnɪŋz bɪˈlɔŋ tu ðə bʌs/
dialogue.zh: 放著吧，早上的時間是屬於公車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten to eight, that is the bus.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn tu eɪt ðæt ɪz ðə bʌs/
dialogue.zh: 七點五十，公車就發車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So finish oats, the walk is nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈfɪnɪʃ oʊts ðə wɔk ɪz naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 所以快點吃完，走路要九分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine minutes walking, that is fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ˈmɪnɪts ˈwɔkɪŋ ðæt ɪz faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 走九分鐘，還算輕鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In rain you may take my old coat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn reɪn ju meɪ teɪk maɪ oʊld koʊt/
dialogue.zh: 下雨的話你可以穿我的舊外套。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, I will hang it at school.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks aɪ wɪl hæŋ ɪt ət skul/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，我會把它掛在學校。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, then the coat stays dry there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðɛn ðə koʊt steɪz draɪ ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 好，那外套在那裡會保持乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I leave the plate like this?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ liv ðə pleɪt laɪk ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 盤子我可以這樣留著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, the cat watches it anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /əv kɔrs ðə kæt ˈwɑtʃɪz ɪt ˈɛniˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 當然，貓反正一直在看它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Biscuit steals toast, is that true?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɪskɪt stilz toʊst ɪz ðæt tru/
dialogue.zh: Biscuit 會偷吐司吃，是真的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only crumbs, he is a slow thief.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli krʌmz hi ɪz ə sloʊ θif/
dialogue.zh: 只吃餅屑，牠是遲鈍的小偷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does Sam eat before rowing?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt dʌz sæm it bɪˈfɔr ˈroʊɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: Sam 划船以前都吃什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two bananas, and bread with jam.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu bəˈnænəz ænd brɛd wɪð dʒæm/
dialogue.zh: 兩根香蕉，還有抹醬的麵包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bananas are in the yellow bunch?
dialogue.phonetic: /bəˈnænəz ɑr ɪn ðə ˈjɛloʊ bʌntʃ/
dialogue.zh: 香蕉在那串黃的上面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take one, they ripen by Thursday.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk wʌn ðeɪ ˈraɪpən baɪ ˈθɜrzˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 拿一根，到週四就全熟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you drink tea from a pot?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju drɪŋk ti frʌm ə pɑt/
dialogue.zh: 你們是用茶壺泡茶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The blue pot, it keeps the warmth.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə blu pɑt ɪt kips ðə wɔrmθ/
dialogue.zh: 那壺藍色的，很會保溫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warmth is what I need this morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrmθ ɪz wɑt aɪ nid ðɪs ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 今天上午我最需要的就是暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Another cup, the pot is still full.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈnʌðɚ kʌp ðə pɑt ɪz stɪl fʊl/
dialogue.zh: 再倒一杯，壺裡還滿著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I take the last piece of toast?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ teɪk ðə læst pis əv toʊst/
dialogue.zh: 最後那片吐司我可以拿嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It was yours from the beginning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wʌz jɔrz frʌm ði bɪˈɡɪnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 它一開始就是留給你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You plan breakfast for a guest well.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju plæn ˈbrɛkfəst fɔr ə ɡɛst wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 你很會為客人安排早餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A guest who eats is a happy guest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ɡɛst hu its ɪz ə ˈhæpi ɡɛst/
dialogue.zh: 吃得盡興的客人就是開心的客人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will be back by seven forty.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl bi bæk baɪ ˈsɛvən ˈfɔrti/
dialogue.zh: 我會七點四十以前回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The plate stays covered, do not rush.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pleɪt steɪz ˈkʌvɚd du nɑt rʌʃ/
dialogue.zh: 盤子會蓋著，不用趕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will tomorrow bring the same breakfast?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl təˈmɑroʊ brɪŋ ðə seɪm ˈbrɛkfəst/
dialogue.zh: 明天的早餐也一樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oats on Monday, eggs by Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊts ɑn ˈmʌndeɪ ɛɡz baɪ ˈfraɪˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 週一燕麥，週五以前有蛋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I look forward to Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ lʊk ˈfɔrwərd tu ˈfraɪˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那我會開始期待週五。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Friday also has the pancake stack.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfraɪˌdeɪ ˈɔlsoʊ hæz ðə ˈpænˌkeɪk stæk/
dialogue.zh: 週五還有一疊鬆餅呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pancakes with fruit, that is a feast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpænˌkeɪks wɪð frut ðæt ɪz ə fist/
dialogue.zh: 鬆餅配水果，那是一頓盛宴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ray flips them, I only set the table.
dialogue.phonetic: /reɪ flɪps ðɛm aɪ ˈoʊnli sɛt ðə ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: Ray 負責翻，我只擺桌子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I could learn to flip one.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kʊd lɜrn tu flɪp wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 我也可以學著翻一片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Saturday, eight, kitchen, no hurry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsætɚˌdeɪ eɪt ˈkɪtʃɪn noʊ ˈhɜri/
dialogue.zh: 週六八點，廚房見，不用急。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saturday morning, I will be there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsætɚˌdeɪ ˈmɔrnɪŋ aɪ wɪl bi ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 週六早上我會到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring your appetite, the pan is big.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ jɔr ˈæpətaɪt ðə pæn ɪz bɪɡ/
dialogue.zh: 把好胃口帶來，鍋子很大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Photos on the hall wall, so many.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfoʊtoʊz ɑn ðə hɔl wɔl soʊ ˈmɛni/
dialogue.zh: 走廊牆上掛了好多相框。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten years of pictures, all in order.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn jɪrz əv ˈpɪktʃɚz ɔl ɪn ˈɔrdɚ/
dialogue.zh: 十年的照片，全都照順序排。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This one shows a young man by a bike.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʌn ʃoʊz ə jʌŋ mæn baɪ ə baɪk/
dialogue.zh: 這張是一個年輕人站在腳踏車旁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is Ray at seventeen, the bike was new.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz reɪ æt ˌsɛvənˈtin ðə baɪk wʌz nju/
dialogue.zh: 那是十七歲的 Ray，車子是新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seventeen, he looks so serious.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌsɛvənˈtin hi lʊks soʊ ˈsɪriəs/
dialogue.zh: 十七歲的他看起來好嚴肅。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He says that face won him no friends.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi sɛz ðæt feɪs wʌn hɪm noʊ frɛndz/
dialogue.zh: 他說那張臉讓他交不到朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who is the girl holding the map?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu ɪz ðə ɡɜrl ˈhoʊldɪŋ ðə mæp/
dialogue.zh: 拿著地圖的女孩是誰？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My sister Anne, she draws the good plans.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈsɪstɚ æn ʃi drɔz ðə ɡʊd plænz/
dialogue.zh: 我姊姊 Anne，好路線都是她畫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does Anne live far from here?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz æn lɪv fɑr frʌm hɪr/
dialogue.zh: Anne 住得離這裡遠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two counties, we drive south in June.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈkɑuntiz wi draɪv saʊθ ɪn dʒun/
dialogue.zh: 隔兩個郡，六月我們會開車南下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
