dialogue.text: This frame has a wedding inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs freɪm hæz ə ˈwɛdɪŋ ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 這個相框裡是一張婚禮照。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ours, in the church with the tall door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊɚz ɪn ðə tʃɜrtʃ wɪð ðə tɔl dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 我們的，在那個門很高的教堂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your hair was very short there.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr hɛr wʌz ˈvɛri ʃɔrt ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 照片裡妳的頭髮好短。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ray still teases me about it.
dialogue.phonetic: /reɪ stɪl ˈtizɪz mi əˈbaʊt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: Ray 到現在還拿這個開我玩笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is Sam in this picture?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz sæm ɪn ðɪs ˈpɪktʃɚ/
dialogue.zh: 這張裡的 Sam 在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In a basket, three months old, asleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ə ˈbæskɪt θri mʌnθs oʊld əˈslip/
dialogue.zh: 在籃子裡，三個月大，睡著了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A baby in a picnic basket?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈbeɪbi ɪn ə ˈpɪknɪk ˈbæskɪt/
dialogue.zh: 寶寶放在野餐籃裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It was the only box with shade.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wʌz ði ˈoʊnli bɑks wɪð ʃeɪd/
dialogue.zh: 那是唯一有陰影的籃子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He was a small baby indeed.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi wʌz ə smɔl ˈbeɪbi ɪnˈdid/
dialogue.zh: 他那時候真的很小。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He denies it now, loudly.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi dɪˈnaɪz ɪt naʊ ˈlaʊdli/
dialogue.zh: 他現在會大聲否認。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who took this one of the two of you?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu tʊk ðɪs wʌn əv ðə tu əv ju/
dialogue.zh: 這一張是你們兩個人誰來拍的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A stranger at the bus stop, kindly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈstreɪndʒɚ ət ðə bʌs stɑp ˈkaɪndli/
dialogue.zh: 公車站的一個陌生人，很熱心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The dog here is not Biscuit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dɔɡ hɪr ɪz nɑt ˈbɪskɪt/
dialogue.zh: 這隻狗不是 Biscuit。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is Moss, our dog years ago.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz mɔs aʊɚ dɔɡ jɪrz əˈɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 那是 Moss，多年前的狗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Moss, what a good name for a dog.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɔs wʌt ə ɡʊd neɪm fɔr ə dɔɡ/
dialogue.zh: Moss，這名字真適合狗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He was grey, like wet stone.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi wʌz ɡreɪ laɪk wɛt stoʊn/
dialogue.zh: 他的毛是灰的，像濕石頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the old garden in this photo?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ði oʊld ˈɡɑrdən ɪn ðɪs ˈfoʊtoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 這張照片裡有以前的花園嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, before the shed, when it was grass.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bɪˈfɔr ðə ʃɛd wɛn ɪt wʌz ɡræs/
dialogue.zh: 有，小屋還沒蓋，當時全是草。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Long ago, this house looked clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɔŋ əˈɡoʊ ðɪs haʊs lʊkt klin/
dialogue.zh: 以前這棟房子看起來很乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Painted white, now it is cream.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪntɪd waɪt naʊ ɪt ɪz krim/
dialogue.zh: 當時漆白色，現在是奶油色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Whose are the boots by the door?
dialogue.phonetic: /huz ɑr ðə buʊts baɪ ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 門邊那雙靴子是誰的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ray's father, he gardened in all weather.
dialogue.phonetic: /reɪz ˈfɑðɚ hi ˈɡɑrdənd ɪn ɔl ˈwɛðɚ/
dialogue.zh: Ray 的父親，什麼天氣都在園裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a picture of him here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə ˈpɪktʃɚ əv hɪm hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 這裡有他的照片嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The one with the tomato basket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wʌn wɪð ðə təˈmeɪtoʊ ˈbæskɪt/
dialogue.zh: 就是抱著番茄籃那張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He is holding so many tomatoes.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi ɪz ˈhoʊldɪŋ soʊ ˈmɛni təˈmeɪtoʊz/
dialogue.zh: 他手上捧了好多番茄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The year the garden fed the street.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði jɪr ðə ˈɡɑrdən fɛd ðə striːt/
dialogue.zh: 那一年花園養了一條街。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A whole street from one garden?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə hoʊl striːt frʌm wʌn ˈɡɑrdən/
dialogue.zh: 一條街都靠這座花園？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He gave them away, all summer.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi ɡeɪv ðɛm əˈweɪ ɔl ˈsʌmɚ/
dialogue.zh: 他整個夏天都送人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is an album in the drawer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ən ˈælbəm ɪn ðə drɔr/
dialogue.zh: 抽屜裡有一本相簿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Brown paper, keep it flat, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /braʊn ˈpeɪpɚ kip ɪt flæt pliz/
dialogue.zh: 牛皮紙封面，請把它放平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I look through it this weekend?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ lʊk θru ɪt ðɪs ˈwikˌend/
dialogue.zh: 這個週末我可以翻一翻嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sunday after lunch, the light is best.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌnˌdeɪ ˈæftɚ lʌntʃ ðə laɪt ɪz bɛst/
dialogue.zh: 週日吃飽以後，那時光線最好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Best light for old photographs, yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛst laɪt fɔr oʊld ˈfoʊtəˌɡræfs jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 舊照片當然要用最好的光。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And no water near them, they curl.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd noʊ ˈwɔtɚ nɪr ðɛm ðeɪ kɜrl/
dialogue.zh: 附近別放水杯，紙會皺起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who is the woman at the sea?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu ɪz ðə ˈwʊmən ət ðə si/
dialogue.zh: 海邊的那位女士是誰？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My mother, the year she learned to swim.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈmʌðɚ ði jɪr ʃi lɜrnd tu swɪm/
dialogue.zh: 我媽媽，她學會游泳的那年。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She looks proud, and a little cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi lʊks praʊd ænd ə ˈlɪtəl koʊld/
dialogue.zh: 她看起來很驕傲，也有點冷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The sea there is cold in July.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði si ðɛr ɪz koʊld ɪn dʒʊˈlaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那裡的海到七月也是涼的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is that sea, on the map?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz ðæt si ɑn ðə mæp/
dialogue.zh: 在地圖上那片海在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: East, three hours by the slow train.
dialogue.phonetic: /ist θri ˈaʊərz baɪ ðə sloʊ treɪn/
dialogue.zh: 東邊，搭慢車三小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A slow train sounds like a holiday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə sloʊ treɪn saʊndz laɪk ə ˈhɑləˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 慢車聽起來就很像度假。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It was, we went every August.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wʌz wi wɛnt ˈɛvri ˈɔɡəst/
dialogue.zh: 確實是，我們每年八月都去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every August, the same little hotel?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri ˈɔɡəst ðə seɪm ˈlɪtəl hoʊˈtɛl/
dialogue.zh: 每年八月，都住那間小旅館？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Room six, with the blue curtains.
dialogue.phonetic: /rum sɪks wɪð ðə blu ˈkɜrtənz/
dialogue.zh: 六號房，窗簾是藍色的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blue curtains, like your kitchen chair.
dialogue.phonetic: /blu ˈkɜrtənz laɪk jɔr ˈkɪtʃɪn tʃɛr/
dialogue.zh: 藍色窗簾，像你家那張椅子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My mother chose both, she decided fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈmʌðɚ tʃoʊz boʊθ ʃi dɪˈsaɪdəd fæst/
dialogue.zh: 兩樣都是我媽媽挑的，她很快決定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a photo of Sam's team.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə ˈfoʊtoʊ əv sæmz tim/
dialogue.zh: 這一張是 Sam 的隊伍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight boys, one oar each, very serious.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt bɔɪz wʌn ɔr itʃ ˈvɛri ˈsɪriəs/
dialogue.zh: 八個男孩，一人一槳，都很認真。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sam is the tall one, on the left.
dialogue.phonetic: /sæm ɪz ðə tɔl wʌn ɑn ðə lɛft/
dialogue.zh: Sam 是左邊那個高的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He was the tall one, even at ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi wʌz ðə tɔl wʌn ˈivɪn æt tɛn/
dialogue.zh: 他十歲就是最高的一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does he like the rowing still?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz hi laɪk ðə ˈroʊɪŋ stɪl/
dialogue.zh: 他現在還喜歡划船嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He loves the early water, not the coach.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi lʌvz ði ˈɜrli ˈwɔtɚ nɑt ðə koʊtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 他愛清晨的水面，不愛教練。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This picture shows a mountain, doesn't it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈpɪktʃɚ ʃoʊz ə ˈmaʊntɪn ˈdʌzənt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 這張拍的是山，不對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hills, actually, the walk from Anne's.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪlz ˈæktʃuəli ðə wɔk frʌm ænz/
dialogue.zh: 其實是丘陵，Anne 帶的行程。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A hill walk with ten people on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə hɪl wɔk wɪð tɛn ˈpipəl ɑn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 山上走了十個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone fits because the lens was wide.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvriˌwʌn fɪts bɪˈkɔz ðə lɛnz wʌz waɪd/
dialogue.zh: 因為鏡頭寬，人人都進得去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the date under the photo?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt ɪz ðə deɪt ˈʌndɚ ðə ˈfoʊtoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 照片下面的日期是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nineteen ninety four, in pencil.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪnˈtin ˈnaɪnti fɔr ɪn ˈpɛnsəl/
dialogue.zh: 一九九四年，用鉛筆寫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pencil dates last longer, my grandmother said.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɛnsəl deɪts læst ˈlɔŋɡɚ maɪ ˈɡrænˌmʌðɚ sɛd/
dialogue.zh: 我阿嬤說鉛筆寫的日期比較持久。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She wrote every photo by hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi roʊt ˈɛvri ˈfoʊtoʊ baɪ hænd/
dialogue.zh: 每張照片都是她用手寫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her writing is very small here.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɜr ˈraɪtɪŋ ɪz ˈvɛri smɔl hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 她的字在這裡寫得好小。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She saved paper, and time, too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi seɪvd ˈpeɪpɚ ænd taɪm tu/
dialogue.zh: 她省紙，也省時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I see the one of the boat?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ si ðə wʌn əv ðə boʊt/
dialogue.zh: 我能看一下那張船的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The last shelf, under the maps.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə læst ʃɛlf ˈʌndɚ ðə mæps/
dialogue.zh: 最後那一層，收在地圖下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The boat has a name, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə boʊt hæz ə neɪm aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 這艘船好像有名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Little Storm, Ray's first rowing boat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɪtəl stɔrm reɪz fɜrst ˈroʊɪŋ boʊt/
dialogue.zh: 小風暴，Ray 的第一艘划艇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ray kept the rowing boat indoors?
dialogue.phonetic: /reɪ kɛpt ðə ˈroʊɪŋ boʊt ˌɪnˈdɔrz/
dialogue.zh: Ray 把划艇收在室內嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the shed, that is what it is for.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðə ʃɛd ðæt ɪz wʌt ɪt ɪz fɔr/
dialogue.zh: 放在小屋裡，那間就是為它蓋的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The shed is locked, may I look?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ʃɛd ɪz lɑkt meɪ aɪ lʊk/
dialogue.zh: 小屋上鎖了，我還能看嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sunday, with Ray, he loves to show it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌnˌdeɪ wɪð reɪ hi lʌvz tu ʃoʊ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 週日跟 Ray 一起去，他愛展示。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more frame is empty here.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr freɪm ɪz ˈɛmpti hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 這裡還有一個空相框。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yours, when you send us one.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔrz wɛn ju sɛnd ʌs wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 留給你的，等你寄照片來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You want a photo from me, here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju wɑnt ə ˈfoʊtoʊ frʌm mi hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 你們要在這裡放一張我的照片？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: An empty frame waits all year.
dialogue.phonetic: /ən ˈɛmpti freɪm weɪts ɔl jɪr/
dialogue.zh: 空相框已經等了一整年。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will print one from my phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl prɪnt wʌn frʌm maɪ foʊn/
dialogue.zh: 我會從手機洗一張出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shop near the station prints fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ʃɑp nɪr ðə ˈsteɪʃən prɪnts fæst/
dialogue.zh: 車站旁那家店沖印很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which picture should I send first?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈpɪktʃɚ ʃʊd aɪ sɛnd fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 我該先寄哪一張？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The garden in spring, with the snowdrops.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈɡɑrdən ɪn sprɪŋ wɪð ðə ˈsnoʊˌdrɑps/
dialogue.zh: 春天花園那張，有雪滴花的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Spring snowdrops, that is my favorite.
dialogue.phonetic: /sprɪŋ ˈsnoʊˌdrɑps ðæt ɪz maɪ ˈfeɪvərɪt/
dialogue.zh: 春天的雪滴花，那是我的最愛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They bloom once, ask me in March.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ blum wʌns æsk mi ɪn mɑrtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 一年開一回，三月問我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will ask, I like the plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl æsk aɪ laɪk ðə plæn/
dialogue.zh: 我會問的，我喜歡這個安排。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One frame, one promise, that is fair.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn freɪm wʌn ˈprɑmɪs ðæt ɪz fɛr/
dialogue.zh: 一個相框換一個承諾，很公道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a small clock with pictures.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə smɔl klɑk wɪð ˈpɪktʃɚz/
dialogue.zh: 有一座附照片的小鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It ticks at night, nobody minds.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt tɪks ət naɪt ˈnoʊˌbɑdi maɪndz/
dialogue.zh: 夜裡會喀啦響，沒人在意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nobody minds, what a calm house.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊˌbɑdi maɪndz wʌt ə kɑm haʊs/
dialogue.zh: 沒人介意，這屋子真平靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Photographs make people speak softly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfoʊtəˌɡræfs meɪk ˈpipəl spik ˈsɔftli/
dialogue.zh: 看照片時，人都會小聲說話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will speak softly, I promise.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl spik ˈsɔftli aɪ ˈprɑmɪs/
dialogue.zh: 我會輕聲說話，我答應。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then Sunday, tea and the album.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈsʌnˌdeɪ ti ænd ði ˈælbəm/
dialogue.zh: 那就週日，泡茶，一起看相簿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sunday album, I will set the table.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌnˌdeɪ ˈælbəm aɪ wɪl sɛt ðə ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 週日看相簿，我來擺桌子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The frames will wait for you, all week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə freɪmz wɪl weɪt fɔr ju ɔl wik/
dialogue.zh: 這些相框整個星期都在等你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thursday nights, the library closes late.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrzˌdeɪ naɪts ðə ˈlaɪˌbɛri ˈkloʊzɪz leɪt/
dialogue.zh: 週四晚上圖書館關得比較晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then send me a note, that is all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn sɛnd mi ə noʊt ðæt ɪz ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 那就傳個短訊給我，這樣就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A note like, home near nine tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə noʊt laɪk hoʊm nɪr naɪn təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 短訊就寫「大約九點到家」？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly that, four small words.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ðæt fɔr smɔl wɜrdz/
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣，只要四個字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And if the bus is very late?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪf ðə bʌs ɪz ˈvɛri leɪt/
dialogue.zh: 如果公車晚很多呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send the same note, from the stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛnd ðə seɪm noʊt frʌm ðə stɑp/
dialogue.zh: 在站上發同一句話就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you wait up for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju weɪt ʌp fɔr mi/
dialogue.zh: 你會等我回來才睡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, but my phone stays on.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ bʌt maɪ foʊn steɪz ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 不會，不過我的手機開著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is kind, I will not test it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz kaɪnd aɪ wɪl nɑt tɛst ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 這樣很好，我不會故意試。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Test it, a message is enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛst ɪt ə ˈmɛsɪdʒ ɪz ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 你可以試試，傳訊息就夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is nine the rule for all students?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz naɪn ðə rul fɔr ɔl ˈstjudənts/
dialogue.zh: 九點是對所有學生的規定嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine on weekdays, ten at weekend.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ɑn ˈwikˌdeɪz tɛn æt ˈwikˌend/
dialogue.zh: 平日九點，週末可以到十點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Weekend until ten, that is good.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwikˌend ʌnˈtɪl tɛn ðæt ɪz ɡʊd/
dialogue.zh: 週末到十點，這很不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are not a child, ten is fair.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr nɑt ə tʃaɪld tɛn ɪz fɛr/
dialogue.zh: 你不是小孩，十點很合理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to say where I go?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tu seɪ wɛr aɪ ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我要說我自己去哪裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just the place, the bus stop is fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ðə pleɪs ðə bʌs stɑp ɪz faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 只說地方，寫公車站也可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Today I go to the river bank.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈdeɪ aɪ ɡoʊ tu ðə ˈrɪvɚ bæŋk/
dialogue.zh: 我今天要去河堤那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Watch the steps, they are mossy there.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑtʃ ðə stɛps ðeɪ ɑr ˈmɔsi ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 留意石階，那裡長了青苔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mossy steps, I will use the lamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɔsi stɛps aɪ wɪl juz ðə læm/
dialogue.zh: 有青苔的階梯，我會用小燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your small torch lives in my drawer.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr smɔl tɔrtʃ lɪvz ɪn maɪ drɔr/
dialogue.zh: 你的小手電在我抽屜裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is bright, I tested it once.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz braɪt aɪ ˈtɛstɪd ɪt wʌns/
dialogue.zh: 它很亮，我試過一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ray tests it every October.
dialogue.phonetic: /reɪ tɛsts ɪt ˈɛvri ɑkˈtoʊbɚ/
dialogue.zh: Ray 每年十月都會檢查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if my phone battery dies?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt ɪf maɪ foʊn ˈbætəri daɪz/
dialogue.zh: 如果我手機沒電了怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then come in softly, the gate is open.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn kʌm ɪn ˈsɔftli ðə ɡeɪt ɪz ˈoʊpən/
dialogue.zh: 那就輕聲進門，側門會開著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before I go, I will charge it.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈfɔr aɪ ɡoʊ aɪ wɪl tʃɑrdʒ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 出門前我會先充電。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half is enough, the walk is short.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ɪz ɪˈnʌf ðə wɔk ɪz ʃɔrt/
dialogue.zh: 充到一半就好，路不遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who do I message, you or Ray?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu du aɪ ˈmɛsɪdʒ ju ɔr reɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我要傳訊息給誰，妳還是 Ray？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only me, Ray sleeps with his phone off.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli mi reɪ sleeps wɪð hɪz foʊn ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 只給我，Ray 關機睡覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His phone off, that is discipline.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪz foʊn ɔf ðæt ɪz ˈdɪsəplɪn/
dialogue.zh: 手機關機，這很自律。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He calls it a good night rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi kɔlz ɪt ə ɡʊd naɪt rul/
dialogue.zh: 他把它叫做晚安規則。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I have a good night rule, too?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ hæv ə ɡʊd naɪt rul tu/
dialogue.zh: 那我也有晚安規則了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Message, gate, lamp off, sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɛsɪdʒ ɡeɪt læm ɔf slip/
dialogue.zh: 傳訊息、進側門、關燈、睡覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four small steps, I can do that.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr smɔl stɛps aɪ kæn du ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 四個小步驟，我做得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You did it Sunday, without help.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju dɪd ɪt ˈsʌndeɪ wɪˈðaʊt hɛlp/
dialogue.zh: 週日你自己就做到了，沒有人提醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yesterday I almost forgot, I felt bad.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjɛstɚˌdeɪ aɪ ˈɔlmoʊst fəˈɡɔt aɪ fɛlt bæd/
dialogue.zh: 昨天我差點忘了傳，心裡很難受。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I worried, then I made tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈwɜrid ðɛn aɪ meɪd ti/
dialogue.zh: 我擔心了一陣，然後去泡茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please do not wait up for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz du nɑt weɪt ʌp fɔr mi/
dialogue.zh: 請不要等我才睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I do not, I trust the message.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ du nɑt aɪ trʌst ðə ˈmɛsɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 我不等，我相信那則訊息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The message lands, then you sleep?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmɛsɪdʒ lændz ðɛn ju slip/
dialogue.zh: 訊息送到以後妳就睡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I read it, then I turn off.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ rid ɪt ðɛn aɪ tɜrn ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 我讀過了，才關燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the hall lamp your good night sign?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə hɔl læm jɔr ɡʊd naɪt saɪn/
dialogue.zh: 走廊那盞燈是妳的晚安訊號嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, lit till the gate closes.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs lɪt tɪl ðə ɡeɪt ˈkloʊzɪz/
dialogue.zh: 對，它亮到側門關起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So a dark lamp means all is well.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ə dɑrk læm minz ɔl ɪz wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 燈滅了就代表一切都好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It means the house is asleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt minz ðə haʊs ɪz əˈslip/
dialogue.zh: 它代表這間屋子睡著了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What did Sam message last night?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt dɪd sæm ˈmɛsɪdʒ læst naɪt/
dialogue.zh: Sam 昨晚傳了什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two words, late bus, that was all.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu wɜrdz leɪt bʌs ðæt wʌz ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 兩個字，公車晚點，就這些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does Sam ever forget to send?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz sæm ˈɛvɚ fɚˈɡɛt tu sɛnd/
dialogue.zh: Sam 偶爾也會忘記傳嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twice a term, then he washes dishes.
dialogue.phonetic: /twaɪs ə tɜrm ðɛn hi ˈwɑʃɪz ˈdɪʃɪz/
dialogue.zh: 一學期兩次，然後他洗碗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Washing dishes as a punishment?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɑʃɪŋ ˈdɪʃɪz əz ə ˈpʌnɪʃmənt/
dialogue.zh: 洗碗算是處罰嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not punishment, just the deal.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ˈpʌnɪʃmənt dʒʌst ðə dil/
dialogue.zh: 不是處罰，只是說好的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I also will wash, if I forget.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ ˈɔlsoʊ wɪl wɑʃ ɪf aɪ fɚˈɡɛt/
dialogue.zh: 那我忘記的時候也洗碗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You will not forget, you like the note.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju wɪl nɑt fɚˈɡɛt ju laɪk ðə noʊt/
dialogue.zh: 你不會忘的，你喜歡發短訊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sending is quick, three taps only.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛndɪŋ ɪz kwɪk θri tæps ˈoʊnli/
dialogue.zh: 傳出去很快，按三下就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it saved, do not rewrite.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ɪt seɪvd du nɑt riˈraɪt/
dialogue.zh: 把它存成草稿，不用重打。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The draft says, home by nine thirty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dræft sɛz hoʊm baɪ naɪn ˈθɜrdi/
dialogue.zh: 草稿寫著九點半到家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send it, my reply will be one dot.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛnd ɪt maɪ rɪˈplaɪ wɪl bi wʌn dɑt/
dialogue.zh: 發送吧，我會回一個句號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A dot means seen, that is the code?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə dɑt minz sin ðæt ɪz ði koʊd/
dialogue.zh: 一個句號代表已讀，這是暗號嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It means, sleep well, nothing else.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt minz slip wɛl ˈnʌθɪŋ ɛls/
dialogue.zh: 它的意思是好好睡，沒別的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing else, that is easy to obey.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ ɛls ðæt ɪz ˈizi tu əˈbeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 沒有別的事，這種規定很好守。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We all obey better at night.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɔl əˈbeɪ ˈbɛtɚ ət naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 到了夜裡，我們都更守規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the road dark from the stop?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə roʊd dɑrk frʌm ðə stɑp/
dialogue.zh: 從車站到這裡的路黑嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two lamps on the way, then trees.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu læmpz ɑn ðə weɪ ðɛn triz/
dialogue.zh: 路上有兩盞燈，再過去是樹林。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Trees are fine, I walked them today.
dialogue.phonetic: /triz ɑr faɪn aɪ wɔkt ðɛm təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 樹林沒關係，我今天走過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the path knows your feet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə pæθ noʊz jɔr fit/
dialogue.zh: 那小路已經認得你的腳步。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I ask the bus to wait once?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ æsk ðə bʌs tu weɪt wʌns/
dialogue.zh: 我能請公車等我一次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never, but the next one comes fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvɚ bʌt ðə nɛkst wʌn kʌmz fæst/
dialogue.zh: 不行，不過下一班很快來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve minutes, the app says it.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv ˈmɪnɪts ði æp sɛz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 十二分鐘，應用程式這樣說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stand at the shelter, it is lit.
dialogue.phonetic: /stænd ət ðə ˈʃɛltɚ ɪt ɪz lɪt/
dialogue.zh: 站在候車亭，那裡有燈光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, a lit shelter is a gift.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ə lɪt ˈʃɛltɚ ɪz ə ɡɪft/
dialogue.zh: 很好，有燈的候車亭是禮物。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ray replaced that bulb in March.
dialogue.phonetic: /reɪ riˈpleɪst ðæt bʌlb ɪn mɑrtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 那個燈泡是 Ray 三月換的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Of course, Ray and his ladder.
dialogue.phonetic: /əv kɔrs reɪ ænd hɪz ˈlædɚ/
dialogue.zh: 果然，Ray 和他的梯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The ladder lives in the shed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈlædɚ lɪvz ɪn ðə ʃɛd/
dialogue.zh: 梯子一直放在工具小屋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing, what about Sunday?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr θɪŋ wɑt əˈbaʊt ˈsʌnˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事，週日怎麼算？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sunday is church, then the long walk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌnˌdeɪ ɪz tʃɜrtʃ ðɛn ðə lɔŋ wɔk/
dialogue.zh: 週日先去教堂，然後走長路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A long walk home, before ten?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə lɔŋ wɔk hoʊm bɪˈfɔr tɛn/
dialogue.zh: 走很長的路回家，十點前？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we stop for soup on the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wi stɑp fɔr sup ɑn ðə weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 對，中途會停下來喝湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soup in a cup, like a child.
dialogue.phonetic: /sup ɪn ə kʌp laɪk ə tʃaɪld/
dialogue.zh: 用杯子喝湯，像個小孩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In a bowl, at the corner shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ə boʊl ət ðə ˈkɔrnɚ ʃɑp/
dialogue.zh: 是用碗，在轉角那家店。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The corner shop has good soup, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkɔrnɚ ʃɑp hæz ɡʊd sup ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那家轉角店的湯不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomato on Thursdays, that is our night.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈmeɪtoʊ ɑn ˈθɜrzˌdeɪz ðæt ɪz aʊɚ naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 週四有番茄湯，那是我們的日子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thursdays are full of soup and rain.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrzˌdeɪz ɑr fʊl əv sup ænd reɪn/
dialogue.zh: 週四總是滿是湯和雨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring the boots, and your notebook.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ðə buʊts ænd jɔr ˈnoʊtˌbʊk/
dialogue.zh: 記得帶雨靴，還有筆記本。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Notebook for the album, right.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊtˌbʊk fɔr ði ˈælbəm raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 筆記本是為了那本相簿，對吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write the names, we will read them.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ðə neɪmz wi wɪl rid ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 把名字寫下來，我們會慢慢讀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I write in pencil, like my grandmother?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ raɪt ɪn ˈpɛnsəl laɪk maɪ ˈɡrænmʌðɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我可以像我阿嬤那樣，用鉛筆寫嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pencil always, so the dates stay clear.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɛnsəl ˈɔlweɪz soʊ ðə deɪts steɪ klɪr/
dialogue.zh: 永遠用鉛筆，日期才會清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last night I texted at nine five.
dialogue.phonetic: /læst naɪt aɪ ˈtɛkstɪd æt naɪn faɪv/
dialogue.zh: 昨晚我九點零五分傳了訊息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I saw it, and I slept well.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sɔ ɪt ænd aɪ slɛpt wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 我看見了，那天睡得安穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is the best reply, a good sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə bɛst rɪˈplaɪ ə ɡʊd slip/
dialogue.zh: 那就是最好的回應，好眠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yours too, I hope, in your bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔrz tu aɪ hoʊp ɪn jɔr bɛd/
dialogue.zh: 希望你也是，在你的床上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I sleep well now, the room is quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ slip wɛl naʊ ðə rum ɪz ˈkwaɪət/
dialogue.zh: 我現在睡得很好，房間很靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quiet after ten, that is the deal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkwaɪət ˈæftɚ tɛn ðæt ɪz ðə dil/
dialogue.zh: 十點以後安靜，這是我們的約。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The deal, the note, and the gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dil ðə noʊt ænd ðə ɡeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 約定、短訊，還有側門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three small things, one calm house.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri smɔl θɪŋz wʌn kɑm haʊs/
dialogue.zh: 三件小事，換一屋子平靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tonight I will send at eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈnaɪt aɪ wɪl sɛnd æt eɪt/
dialogue.zh: 今晚我會八點就傳訊息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And I will leave the lamp lit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd aɪ wɪl liv ðə læm lɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我會把那盞燈留亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You do not need to wait for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju du nɑt nid tu weɪt fɔr mi/
dialogue.zh: 妳不需要等我回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am not waiting, just reading.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm nɑt ˈweɪtɪŋ dʒʌst ˈridɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我沒在等，只是在看書。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good night, then, and thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naɪt ðɛn ænd θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 那就晚安，謝謝妳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good night, the gate is on the latch.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naɪt ðə ɡeɪt ɪz ɑn ðə lætʃ/
dialogue.zh: 晚安，側門只扣了門閂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My last night here is on Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ læst naɪt hɪr ɪz ɑn ˈfraɪˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我在這裡的最後一晚是週五。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Already, the week went so fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔlˈrɛdi ðə wik wɛnt soʊ fæst/
dialogue.zh: 是啊，這一週過得好快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I must pack, the bag is waiting.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ mʌst pæk ðə bæɡ ɪz ˈweɪtɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我該收行李了，袋子在等著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave the shelves, we will clean them.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv ðə ʃɛlvz wi wɪl klin ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 架子不用管，我們會擦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, I will wipe the shelf myself.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ aɪ wɪl waɪp ðə ʃɛlf maɪˈsɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 不，架子我要自己擦乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then a dry cloth, the wood is soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ə draɪ klɔθ ðə wʊd ɪz sɔft/
dialogue.zh: 那就用乾布，木頭很軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is one gift in my bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz wʌn ɡɪft ɪn maɪ bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 我的袋子裡有一份小禮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A gift, for whom, tell me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ɡɪft fɔr hum tɛl mi/
dialogue.zh: 禮物？要送誰，說給我聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: For the whole house, a small box.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ðə hoʊl haʊs ə smɔl bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 送這一家人，一個小盒子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You brought something through the rain?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju brɔt ˈsʌmθɪŋ θru ðə reɪn/
dialogue.zh: 你冒雨把這個帶了來？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two weeks ago, in a Taipei shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu wikz əˈɡoʊ ɪn ə ˌtaɪˈpeɪ ʃɑp/
dialogue.zh: 兩週前，在台北一家店裡買的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A shop you chose on purpose.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ʃɑp ju tʃoʊz ɑn ˈpɜrpəs/
dialogue.zh: 你是特意去那家店挑的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is tea, twelve small packs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ti twɛlv smɔl pæks/
dialogue.zh: 是茶，十二小包。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For our tea pot, in the morning?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr aʊɚ ti pɑt ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 配我們的茶壺，早上喝嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, it is oolong, a light one.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt ɪz ˈuˌlɔŋ ə laɪt wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 對，是烏龍茶，味道清淡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ray will want to read the box.
dialogue.phonetic: /reɪ wɪl wɑnt tu rid ðə bɑks/
dialogue.zh: Ray 一定想把盒子看來看去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chinese on the box, I can teach it.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃaɪˈniz ɑn ðə bɑks aɪ kæn titʃ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 盒子上有中文，我可以教你們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two words only, the name and year.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu wɜrdz ˈoʊnli ðə neɪm ænd jɪr/
dialogue.zh: 只教兩個字，名字和年份。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oolong, autumn, written in ink.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈuˌlɔŋ ˈɔtəm ˈrɪtn ɪn ɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 烏龍，秋天，用墨水寫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then it belongs on our shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɪt bɪˈlɔŋz ɑn aʊɚ ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 那它就該放在我們架上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a fan inside, too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə fæn ɪnˈsaɪd tu/
dialogue.zh: 裡面還有一把扇子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A paper fan, for my summer?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈpeɪpɚ fæn fɔr maɪ ˈsʌmɚ/
dialogue.zh: 紙扇子，是給我夏天用的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Painted with the bird table.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪntɪd wɪð ðə bɜrd ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 上面畫了餵鳥的小台。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You drew our garden on it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju dru aʊɚ ˈɡɑrdən ɑn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你把我們的花園畫在上面了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I copied it, badly, from the window.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈkɑpid ɪt ˈbædli frʌm ðə ˈwɪnˌdoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我照著窗景臨的，畫得不好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The birds are there, I see them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɜrdz ɑr ðɛr aɪ si ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 鳥就在上面，我看見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I hang it on the wall?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ hæŋ ɪt ɑn ðə wɔl/
dialogue.zh: 我可以把它掛在牆上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Beside the frames, by the empty one.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈsaɪd ðə freɪmz baɪ ði ˈɛmpti wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 掛在相框那一排，空的那個旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The empty frame, for my photo.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈɛmpti freɪm fɔr maɪ ˈfoʊtoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 那個空框是留給我的照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Printed yesterday, in the shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈprɪntɪd ˈjɛstɚˌdeɪ ɪn ðə ʃɑp/
dialogue.zh: 昨天在列印店洗好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here it is, me at the gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪt ɪz mi ət ðə ɡeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 就在這裡，我在柵門口的樣子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The first evening, with the wet coat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði fɜrst ˈivnɪŋ wɪð ðə wɛt koʊt/
dialogue.zh: 第一個晚上，外套還是濕的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put it in the frame now, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ɪt ɪn ðə freɪm naʊ pliz/
dialogue.zh: 請現在就把它放進框裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ray will need a step and a nail.
dialogue.phonetic: /reɪ wɪl nid ə stɛp ænd ə neɪl/
dialogue.zh: Ray 要搬凳子和釘子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There, it hangs, level and straight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪt hæŋz ˈlɛvəl ænd streɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好了，掛正了，平平的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better than mine, on the left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛtɚ ðæn maɪn ɑn ðə lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 比我左邊那張掛得正。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have a card for you also.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ə kɑrd fɔr ju ˈɔlsoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我還有一張卡片要給妳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A card, from you, written by hand?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə kɑrd frʌm ju ˈrɪtn baɪ hænd/
dialogue.zh: 卡片，你親手寫的那種？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four lines, nothing long, nothing hard.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr laɪnz ˈnʌθɪŋ lɔŋ ˈnʌθɪŋ hɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 只有四行，不長，也不難。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will keep it in the album.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl kip ɪt ɪn ði ˈælbəm/
dialogue.zh: 我會把它收在相簿裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The album has room for one more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈælbəm hæz rum fɔr wʌn mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 相簿還塞得下一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sunday's page is still blank.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌnˌdeɪz peɪdʒ ɪz stɪl blæŋk/
dialogue.zh: 週日那一頁還空著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blank for the gift you gave me.
dialogue.phonetic: /blæŋk fɔr ðə ɡɪft ju ɡeɪv mi/
dialogue.zh: 空的，留給你們送我的東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We gave you nothing, only toast.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɡeɪv ju ˈnʌθɪŋ ˈoʊnli toʊst/
dialogue.zh: 我們什麼也沒給，只有吐司。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Toast at seven thirty, every day.
dialogue.phonetic: /toʊst æt ˈsɛvən ˈθɜrti ˈɛvri deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 七點半的吐司，天天都有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oats, and the blue pot, and Ray.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊts ænd ðə blu pɑt ænd reɪ/
dialogue.zh: 燕麥、藍茶壺，還有 Ray。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the warm towel rail.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə wɔrm ˈtaʊəl reɪl/
dialogue.zh: 還有那根暖毛巾桿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small things make a house work.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl θɪŋz meɪk ə haʊs wɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 就是這些小事讓家能過日子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My train leaves at ten forty.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ treɪn livz æt tɛn ˈfɔrti/
dialogue.zh: 我的火車十點四十分開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sam will drive you, he is free.
dialogue.phonetic: /sæm wɪl draɪv ju hi ɪz fri/
dialogue.zh: Sam 送你去，他那天有空。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that a rule, or a favor?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ə rul ɔr ə ˈfeɪvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 這是他該做的，還是人情？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A favor, he asked for it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈfeɪvɚ hi æskt fɔr ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 人情，是他自己要求的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I thank him with a pancake?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ θæŋk hɪm wɪð ə ˈpænˌkeɪk/
dialogue.zh: 我能用一塊松餅謝他嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Friday pancakes, you could flip two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfraɪˌdeɪ ˈpænˌkeɪks ju kʊd flɪp tu/
dialogue.zh: 週五有松餅，你可以翻兩片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I flipped one, badly, that Saturday.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ flɪpt wʌn ˈbædli ðæt ˈsætɚˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 上週六我翻了一片，翻壞了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The ceiling remembers it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈsilɪŋ rɪˈmɛmbɚz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 天花板還記得那一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell Sam the pan was heavy.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl sæm ðə pæn wʌz ˈhɛvi/
dialogue.zh: 請告訴 Sam，那鍋子很重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He will laugh, then claim it.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi wɪl læf ðɛn kleɪm ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 他會笑，然後說是他的錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is one thing, about my key.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz wʌn θɪŋ əˈbaʊt maɪ ki/
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事，關於我的鑰匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By the door, the hook holds it fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ðə dɔr ðə hʊk hoʊldz ɪt faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 門邊那個鉤子，就是放鑰匙的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Or may I keep it, for next year?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔr meɪ aɪ kip ɪt fɔr nɛkst jɪr/
dialogue.zh: 或者我能留著，等到明年？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it, the gate will still know you.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ɪt ðə ɡeɪt wɪl stɪl noʊ ju/
dialogue.zh: 留著吧，側門還是在等你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The gate will know me, that is nice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡeɪt wɪl noʊ mi ðæt ɪz naɪs/
dialogue.zh: 側門認得我，這句話真好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Spring comes, you will count snowdrops.
dialogue.phonetic: /sprɪŋ kʌmz ju wɪl kaʊnt ˈsnoʊˌdrɑps/
dialogue.zh: 春天一到，你會來數雪滴花。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My bag is closed, and light now.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ bæɡ ɪz kloʊzd ænd laɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我的袋子收好了，也變輕了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You left the room empty, almost.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju lɛft ðə rum ˈɛmpti ˈɔlmoʊst/
dialogue.zh: 你幾乎把房間清空了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Almost, I left a sponge and soap.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlmoʊst aɪ lɛft ə spʌndʒ ænd soʊp/
dialogue.zh: 差不多，我留了海綿和肥皂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shelf is clean, you did that?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ʃɛlf ɪz klin ju dɪd ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 架子好乾淨，是你擦的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I wiped it, as you asked me.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ waɪpt ɪt æz ju æskt mi/
dialogue.zh: 我照你說的擦過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the next guest starts warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə nɛkst ɡɛst stɑrts wɔrm/
dialogue.zh: 那下一位客人一來就暖和。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a next guest already?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə nɛkst ɡɛst ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 已經有下一位客人了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In October, a boy from Italy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ɑkˈtoʊbɚ ə bɔɪ frʌm ˈɪtəli/
dialogue.zh: 十月有個義大利來的男孩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He will need slippers, and wifi.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi wɪl nid ˈslɪpɚz ænd ˈwaɪfaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 他會需要拖鞋，還有網路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The grey pair is still in the hall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡreɪ pɛr ɪz stɪl ɪn ðə hɔl/
dialogue.zh: 灰色那雙還在玄關。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell him the porch light will be on.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl hɪm ðə pɔrtʃ laɪt wɪl bi ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 跟他說門廊的燈會亮著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will, and the card by the lamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ænd ðə kɑrd baɪ ðə læm/
dialogue.zh: 我會說，還有燈邊那張卡片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, that password card really works.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðæt ˈpæswɜrd kɑrd ˈrɪli wɜrks/
dialogue.zh: 是啊，那張密碼卡片真的有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everything is ready, and warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ ɪz ˈrɛdi ænd wɔrm/
dialogue.zh: 什麼都備好了，而且是暖的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The car will honk at the gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɑr wɪl hɔŋk æt ðə ɡeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 車子會在門口按喇叭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your time, it can wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jɔr taɪm ɪt kæn weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢來，它可以等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Biscuit sits at my feet again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɪskɪt sɪts ət maɪ fit əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: Biscuit 又坐在我腳邊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He does this on leaving days.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi dʌz ðɪs ɑn ˈlivɪŋ deɪz/
dialogue.zh: 牠在有人要離開的日子都這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Leaving days, I did not plan that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlivɪŋ deɪz aɪ dɪd nɑt plæn ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 要離開的日子，我本來沒想這麼多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One hug, and the cat will go.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn hʌɡ ænd ðə kæt wɪl ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 抱一下，牠就會自己走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A hug, yes, may I have one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə hʌɡ jɛs meɪ aɪ hæv wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 抱一下，好嗎？我可以抱一個嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here I am, the kitchen is warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr aɪ æm ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn ɪz wɔrm/
dialogue.zh: 我在這裡，廚房裡很暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you for the first week.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju fɔr ðə fɜrst wik/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你照顧我的第一週。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For the tea, the toast, the bath?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ðə ti ðə toʊst ðə bæθ/
dialogue.zh: 那些茶、吐司和熱水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: For all of it, and the gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ɔl əv ɪt ænd ðə ɡeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 全部，包括那個側門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write when you reach home.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt wɛn ju ritʃ hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 到家了就寫訊息給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One message, home safe, two small words.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈmɛsɪdʒ hoʊm seɪf tu smɔl wɜrdz/
dialogue.zh: 一則訊息，「平安到家」，兩個字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two is plenty, send it soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ɪz ˈplɛnti sɛnd ɪt sun/
dialogue.zh: 兩個字夠了，盡快傳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The station is ten minutes away.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈsteɪʃən ɪz tɛn ˈmɪnɪts əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 車站離這裡十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sam takes the river road, it is flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /sæm teɪks ðə ˈrɪvɚ roʊd ɪt ɪz flæt/
dialogue.zh: Sam 會走河堤那條路，很平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: River road, the one where I rowed?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɪvɚ roʊd ði wʌn wɛr aɪ roʊd/
dialogue.zh: 河堤路，就是我划船那條嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, past the bridge, past the shed.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pæst ðə brɪdʒ pæst ðə ʃɛd/
dialogue.zh: 對，過了橋，再過小屋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will look for the gate light.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl lʊk fɔr ðə ɡeɪt laɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我會找那盞門口的燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It will burn from seven, always.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wɪl bɜrn frʌm ˈsɛvən ˈɔlweɪz/
dialogue.zh: 七點起就會亮，年年如此。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I will find you next spring.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl faɪnd ju nɛkst sprɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那我明年春天再來看你們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The snowdrops, the frames, the tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈsnoʊˌdrɑps ðə freɪmz ðə ti/
dialogue.zh: 雪滴花、相框，還有那壺茶。
